globaltix_product_data.description: Palawan Beach in Sentosa is a stunning tropical paradise known for its pristine white sands and crystal-clear turquoise waters. It offers a serene atmosphere perfect for relaxation and leisure activities. The beach features a picturesque suspension bridge that leads to a small islet, often considered the southernmost point of continental Asia. Surrounded by lush greenery, Palawan Beach provides a family-friendly environment with calm waters suitable for swimming. With various dining options, beachside bars, and recreational facilities, it is an ideal destination for both tranquility and entertainment. Its breathtaking scenery and vibrant ambiance make it a must-visit spot in Sentosa.

globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Tuk Tuks are booked privately, and the price is set based on the number of Tuk Tuks needed for the group, with a legal maximum of 4 passengers per Tuk Tuk. Minimum mandatory age: 2 years Minimum mandatory weight: 9 kg In case of delay, the activity will be reduced based on the time lost, which may cause a change in the fixed route. The activity will be canceled if the delay is greater than 15 minutes and the amount paid will not be refunded. The tour itinerary may vary if there are street closures or demonstrations on the day of the tour. The tours are designed to follow the indicated route and make a series of pre-arranged stops. The 60-minute tour does not includes any stops. The 120-minute tour stops at the Debod, while the 180 and 240-minute tours also stop at Las Ventas and Bernabeu. The Tuk Tuks do not have trunks, so they can't carry large items. This tour runs rain or shine. In winter, the Tuk Tuks have protective layers against rain and wind, and have blankets to keep you warm

options.name: 4-Hour 24 Highlights Tour with Extra Time at the Sights
options.description: Pick-up and drop-off in the (underground) bus station of Plaza de Oriente, right next to the Royal Palace. Although there is no number 4 on Calle Bailén (28013), searching for “Calle Bailén 4” or “Puerta del Príncipe” on Google Maps will mark the exact location of the "Puerta del Príncipe." Directly across from the "Puerta del Príncipe," you will find the stairs leading down to the station. There, you will see our Eco Tuk Tuk signage to guide you to the exact pick-up point. If you have mobility problems getting down the stairs to the pick-up point, please contact the local supplier by phone or message them on WhatsApp at any time, so they can help you access the meeting point by elevator. The tuk tuks are usually always punctual at the time of pickup, but sometimes there is traffic and they are a few minutes late. Whenever there is any delay, you will be notified as far in advance as possible via WhatsApp, iMessage or Mail.

Discover two spectacular theme parks, Disneyland Park and Walt Disney Studios Park, filled with thrilling rides, captivating shows, and unforgettable Disney characters. Step into magical lands, explore immersive attractions, and enjoy world-class entertainment suitable for all ages. Whether you're seeking adventure, family fun, or iconic Disney moments, Disneyland Paris offers an unforgettable experience just outside Paris.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Experience the magic at Disneyland Paris — Europe’s most enchanting destination where fairy tales come to life. Discover two spectacular theme parks, Disneyland Park and Walt Disney Studios Park, filled with thrilling rides, captivating shows, and unforgettable Disney characters. Step into magical l...
globaltix_product_data.description: Experience the magic at Disneyland Paris — Europe’s most enchanting destination where fairy tales come to life. Discover two spectacular theme parks, Disneyland Park and Walt Disney Studios Park, filled with thrilling rides, captivating shows, and unforgettable Disney characters. Step into magical lands, explore immersive attractions, and enjoy world-class entertainment suitable for all ages. Whether you're seeking adventure, family fun, or iconic Disney moments, Disneyland Paris offers an unforgettable experience just outside Paris.
highlights: Enjoy access to two Disney Parks: Disneyland Park & Walt Disney Studios Park
Visit the iconic Sleeping Beauty Castle
Experience immersive attractions at Avengers Campus
Watch spectacular parades, live shows, and nighttime fireworks
Family-friendly attractions for all ages
exclusions: All personal expenses and expenses not mentioned in the inclusions

Cruising on, see the stunning new main station, the majestic Berlin Cathedral, the treasure-filled Museum Island, and the oldest residential area in Berlin, the Nikolaiviertel.

Hop on and off as much as you like at any of the conveniently located stops around the city. With 22 stops around the city, the bus stops near all of Copenhagen's attractions and must-see sights. globaltix_product_data.description: Miyazu Bay, Miyazu City, located in northern Kyoto Prefecture, Japan, has a special natural scenery. Due to tectonic shifts, a sandbar topography was formed in the sea, and in Japan it is called Tango's Amanohashidate, and along with Aki's Miyajima (currently Itsukushima) and Mutsu's Matsushima, it is called one of the "Three Scenic Views of Japan."The name Amanohashidate comes from the fact that if you turn your back on the sandbar from the two hills of Kasamatsu Park, located at the northern end of the sandbar, and Hiryukan, located at the southern end, and look back with your head between your legs, the sandbar appears to be stretching diagonally toward the sky.There is an observatory on Mt. Monju that overlooks Amanohashidate, and on top of the mountain there is a Ferris wheel and attractions that people of all ages can enjoy. Amanohashidate seen from there is called "Hiryukan" because it looks like a dragon dancing in the sky, and you can see the vivid scenery of Amanohashidate. You can take the lift or monorail to the observation deck.
highlights: Explore Amanohashidate, a renowned sandbar in Miyazu Bay, Kyoto Prefecture, revered as one of Japan's "Three Scenic Views.
Ascend Mt. Monju for panoramic views of Amanohashidate, dubbed "Hiryukan" for its dragon-like appearance. Enjoy family attractions atop the mountain
Reach the observation deck easily via lift or monorail, ensuring a seamless experience for all ages to enjoy Amanohashidate's captivating scenery

globaltix_product_data.description: Benefit from contactless entry to the National September 11 Memorial Museum with your pre-purchased timed-entry ticket. Enjoy complimentary access to the 9/11 Memorial, the Survival Tree, and the Memorial Glades The 9/11 MuseumThe museum displays over 10,000 monumental artifacts linked to the events of 9/11 and is made up of three permanent exhibition sections:• The Historical Exhibition has three parts: the Day of 9/11, Before 9/11 and After 9/11. It tells the story of what happened on 9/11, including the events at the World Trade Center and the Pentagon and the story of Flight 93. • The Memorial Exhibition "In Memoriam", commemorates the lives of those who perished on September 11, 2001 and February 26, 1993 and provides visitors with the opportunity to learn about the men, women and children who died.• The Foundation Hall is a room of massive scale, which houses both the last column and the slurry wall.  The 9/11 Memorial (Free Entry)The “National September 11 Memorial” is a tribute of remembrance and honor to the nearly 3,000 people killed in the terror attacks of September 11, 2001 at the World Trade Center site, the Pentagon, as well as the six people killed in the World Trade Center bombing in February 1993. The memorial’s twin reflecting pools are each nearly an acre in size and feature the largest manmade waterfalls in North America. The pools sit within the footprints where the Twin Towers once stood. The names of every person who died in the 2001 and 1993 attacks are inscribed into bronze panels edging the memorial pools.

Pay your respects at the twin reflecting pools at the 9/11 Memorial

globaltix_product_data.description: This is a real working film studio with a theme park built on top of it, and the Studio Tour remains the thing that sets it apart. A tram carries you through active backlots — crashed airliners, flooded streets, the facades of a hundred films you half-recognise — before plunging into King Kong and Fast & Furious sequences on giant screens. Beyond the tour, the park divides across two levels. Above sit The Wizarding World of Harry Potter, with Hogwarts castle rising over Hogsmeade, and Super Nintendo World, where a wearable band lets you punch blocks and collect coins across the whole land. Below are Jurassic World, Transformers and the Revenge of the Mummy coaster. Everything is packed tight into a hillside site, so you move between eras and franchises in a few minutes' walk. Just outside the gate, Universal CityWalk carries the evening on with restaurants, cinemas and live music.

After successfully booking a performance timeslot, visitors must present a printed or digital reservation voucher at the entrance during the specified timeslot for ticket verification. The reservation voucher is only valid for the booked timeslot and expires afterward. Each voucher allows one person to attend one performance timeslot and cannot be reused. Once a show timeslot is successfully reserved, it cannot be refunded or modified, and lost tickets will not be reissued. Please keep your reservation confirmation safe. Please also refrain from running, playing, speaking loudly, or any other behavior that may disturb other guests or compromise safety. In the event of major holidays or private bookings for special timeslots, arrangements will be made separately. Please refer to on-site notices for specific performance schedules. For safety reasons, Shanghai Tower reserves the right to make temporary adjustments to the daily operation plan based on the actual crowd flow. Please follow the instructions of the on-site staff for your visit. We appreciate your understanding. Due to the nature of the interactive experience, laser lights are used during the performance. Direct exposure of laser beams to eyes or light-sensitive components of electronic devices may cause damage. To ensure your personal safety and property protection, please avoid looking directly at laser beams or exposing light-sensitive electronic devices (such as mobile phones, cameras) directly to laser light. In addition to the above visiting guidelines, you must also comply with the entry regulations of the Top of Shanghai Observatory. By purchasing a ticket, you acknowledge that you have carefully read these notices and agree to all ticketing, reservation, and performance regulations of this venue by default. options.name: 118th-Floor Observatory
options.description: Located opposite the Bund, Lujiazui is the heart of China's budding financial sector and the only specifically designated financial development zone on the mainland. Landmark attractions include the Oriental Pearl TV Tower, Shanghai World Financial Center, Jin Mao Tower, and the Shanghai Tower. As night falls, the skyscrapers come alive with lights. The nightscape is breathtaking, showing off the modern metropolis that is Shanghai. Parents can take their kids to the Shanghai Ocean Aquarium to explore the magical wonders beneath the sea. Lujiazui is also home to great shopping and dining. It is a modern neighbourhood in a very modern city. Operating Hours: Daily, 08.30 - 21.30 Additional information: The Top of Shanghai Observatory is located on the 118th floor of the Shanghai Tower. Take the exclusive elevator straight to the clouds and experience a god's-eye view of Shanghai from 546 meters high. Through the 360° panoramic windows, you can take in the Oriental Pearl Tower, Jin Mao Tower, and the Huangpu River.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Nong Nooch Tropical Garden Pattaya is a world-renowned botanical garden and cultural attraction located in Pattaya, Thailand. This expansive park features beautifully landscaped themed gardens, including French gardens, cactus collections, and tropical landscapes. Visitors can also enjoy traditional...
globaltix_product_data.description: Nong Nooch Tropical Garden Pattaya is a world-renowned botanical garden and cultural attraction located in Pattaya, Thailand. This expansive park features beautifully landscaped themed gardens, including French gardens, cactus collections, and tropical landscapes. Visitors can also enjoy traditional Thai cultural performances and unique attractions such as the dinosaur valley. It is an ideal destination for nature lovers, families, and photography enthusiasts. The recommended duration is approximately 2–4 hours or a half-day visit, depending on your pace and selected activities. The experience is self-paced, allowing guests to explore the gardens and attend shows at their convenience. Duration may vary depending on crowd levels, weather conditions, and show schedules. Guests can enter directly using a e-ticket or redeem tickets at the counter if required. Upon arrival, visitors can explore various themed garden zones, enjoy scenic walkways, and take photos at beautifully designed landscapes. Guests may also attend scheduled cultural shows and opt for a sightseeing tram ride for easier navigation. The visit offers a seamless combination of nature, culture, and leisure activities within one attraction.
highlights: Explore expansive themed gardens featuring tropical landscapes, cultural displays, and beautifully landscaped zones.
Discover world-famous botanical collections and unique attractions like dinosaur valley and cultural performances.
Perfect for families, couples, and nature lovers seeking a relaxing and visually stunning experience.
Includes access to garden zones, cultural shows, and optional sightseeing tram within the park.
Ideal for visitors of all ages, from leisure travelers to photography enthusiasts capturing vibrant scenery.

globaltix_product_data.description: Experience the perfect merge of classic art and majestic architecture in the Arabian Peninsula’s first universal museum. Designed by the award-winning French architect, Jean Nouvel, Louvre Abu Dhabi is an impressive spectacle on water. Its legendary name says it all! Backed by loans from legendary museums like Musée du Louvre, Musée d’Orsay, and Centre Pompidou, Louvre Museum Abu Dhabi is a collaborative effort between the governments of Abu Dhabi and France.
highlights: This not only lets you access the Arabian world’s first universal museum, but also experience the world’s only Louvre Museum outside of Paris.
Beyond its celebrated exhibits, the museum stands out for its brilliant architecture, designed by the award-winning architect - Jean Nouvel.
Have a closer look at classic masterworks including the Self-Portrait of Van Gogh and Leonardo da Vinci’s La Belle Ferronnière painting.
See some distinct exhibits including a 3000-year-old bracelet.
Discover over 600 artistic displays arranged in 12 sequences, allowing you to experience all civilizations beginning from pre-historic era.

options.description: Travel through Different Periods & Distinct Civilizations With loans from legendary museums like Musée du Louvre, Musée d’Orsay, and Centre Pompidou, Louvre Abu Dhabi showcases a vast spectrum of objects depicting ancient and the latest contemporary artistic expressions in its massive 86,000-square-foot facility. With its hundreds of exhibits presented chronologically, it will take you through distinct periods, from the pre-historic times and the birth of Islam to the classical age and modern era. Marvel at Captivating Architecture & Inspiring Location Louvre Abu Dhabi Universal Museum is truly an impressive spectacle on water. Designed by the award-winning French architect Jean Nouvel, it encompasses a series of stunning white structures that reflect an Arabian city. In fact, it forms one of the main highlights of the thriving Saadiyat Cultural District, which also hosts museums including the Zayed National Museum and the Guggenheim Museum. Feel the Impressive Rain of Light Effect The museum’s main highlight is its intricate and multi-layered geometric lace dome, enhanced by thousands of star-like cladding patterns. This is inspired by the region’s ancient construction techniques, such as the traditional Falaj water system and interweaved palm leaves. The resulting structure provides elegant perforations, creating a stunning contrast of sunlight and shade. This makes for some stunning Instagram shots.

globaltix_product_data.description: Coconut Oil Village is the administrative center of the island, where the township office, middle school, and bus terminal are all located. Kaiyuan Port near the village is an important gateway for external traffic, and there are traffic boats sailing between Taitung Fugang Fishing Port. There is a lighthouse on the north side. If you climb up here and look into the distance, you can see the beauty of the mountains and seas of Lanyu. Langdao Village is a village with traditional architecture on the island. Here you can admire the thatched huts built by the Yami people half underground. Please be sure to respect the local culture when entering this place. Tourists entering the village for sightseeing should be polite and respect the local culture so as not to offend the taboos. Wukong Cave is named after five huge sea caves, of which the fourth and fifth caves can be connected. On the cliff beside the cave are inlaid traditional handmade pottery figurines depicting biblical stories, which is a manifestation of the craftsmanship of the Yami people. The strange rock landscape of Lanyu has been weathered and eroded by sea water for many years, forming many unique reefs, including Crocodile Rock, Tank Rock, Jade Girl Rock, Hen Rock, Frog Rock, Double Lion Rock, Helmet Rock, Elephant Trunk Rock and Longtou Rock and many more.

globaltix_product_data.description: Frost Magical Ice of Siam Pattaya is an icy amusement park that lets you feel the chill of the Arctic without actually going there. It’s an ice sculpture display in a non-temperate region as the amusement park is kept at a chilly -10 degrees Celsius in the Ice Dome, making it an ideal vacation spot for those looking to escape the sweltering summer months. This is the first ever Ice Dome located in Pattaya with beautiful ice statuettes, exhibits, and fun activities in extreme chilly surroundings. With the three magnificent zones, i.e., the Siam Heaven, the Himmapan Zone, and the Frost Village & Food zone, the Frost Magical Ice of Siam Pattaya becomes Thailand’s perfect vacation spot to escape the boring summer day. From walking around the dome buildings, ice caves, Igloos, and other icy sculptures to sipping a soda served in the glasses made of ice, there are various relaxing activities that can be done here. Since the whole surface of the Ice Dome is made of ice, the visitors are advised to exercise caution while walking as it can get extremely slippery.

globaltix_product_data.name: Mutianyu Great Wall
globaltix_product_data.summary: The Mutianyu Great Wall, an important part of the Ming Dynasty's military defense system, features unique defensive structures such as double-sided battlements and the "Eagle Flies Facing Upward," which hold significant historical research value. This section of the wall stretches 5,400 meters along...
globaltix_product_data.description: The Mutianyu Great Wall, an important part of the Ming Dynasty's military defense system, features unique defensive structures such as double-sided battlements and the "Eagle Flies Facing Upward," which hold significant historical research value. This section of the wall stretches 5,400 meters along the Yanshan Mountain range and includes 23 watchtowers. Among them, the Zhengguan Terrace, composed of three parallel watchtowers, is a rare architectural layout within the Great Wall system. The attraction offers two touring routes: the western route extends from Watchtower 14 to Watchtower 22, passing through the steep "Ox Horn Edge" and the uniquely shaped "Arrow Nock" section. The eastern route runs from Watchtower 6 to Watchtower 1, where the Big Corner Tower provides a vantage point for viewing the surrounding mountain scenery. Visitors are advised to take the cable car to Watchtower 14 and first explore the western route, which features more varied terrain. On the return, they can leisurely descend along the eastern route, with an opportunity to try the toboggan ride at Watchtower 8. Compared to some popular Great Wall sites, Mutianyu has better preserved the historical texture of the wall. The well-developed facilities within the scenic area offer diverse visiting options for tourists with varying levels of physical fitness.
highlights: Discover unique structures like double-sided battlements and the famed “Eagle Flies Facing Upward.”
Enhance your visit with a cable car ride, thrilling toboggan descent, and well-developed visitor facilities.

globaltix_product_data.description: See FIVE of the best, most essential attractions in Sydney all at a single low price with the "Ultimate Sydney Experience" attractions pass! Leave no sightseeing stone unturned as you get access and admission to some spectacular scenery from both up high and down below! The Ultimate Sydney Experience includes entry to Sydney Tower Eye and its SKYWALK experience, WILD LIFE Sydney Zoo, SEA LIFE Sydney Aquarium and Madame Tussauds Sydney. Travel to the highest point in Sydney by ascending the famous Sydney Tower Eye for spectacular 360 degree views of the city and its famous harbour icons, then go a step further with the SKYWALK experience that offers the ultimate outdoor view as you travel AROUND the tower's exterior! Next up, get a double-dose of animals both on land and water with visits to the all-Aussie animal adventure that is WILD LIFE Sydney, and one of the world's best aquariums SEA LIFE Sydney Aquarium - both of which offer spectacular journeys through a huge range of diverse marine environments. Lastly, step onto the red carpet at the incredible and all new Madame Tussauds Sydney, located right next door to WILD LIFE Sydney and SEA LIFE Sydney. Great value and great experiences make the Ultimate Sydney Experience one not to miss! For a pass that showcases the very best of Sydney's attractions all at an excellent price, this is it!

Many details in the village have been reproduced after strict research. Passing through the main gate o...
globaltix_product_data.description: Noboribetsu Date Jidai Mura is a theme park that recreates the streetscape of the Edo period (1600-1864), with the main theme of watching dramas and experiencing the social situation at that time. Many details in the village have been reproduced after strict research. Passing through the main gate of the castle, Otemon, you can reach the shopping street (Shouka Gai) where the commodity economy was active and prosperous in the Edo period, and the "Sitamachi" area where common people living in low-lying areas in the Edo period lived. There are 94 wooden buildings in total, in addition to a large ninja theater with a high-definition screen and high-fidelity sound, an oiran theater where you can watch famous prostitutes, and ninja fighting and martial arts shows. "Ancient people" in Edo costumes walk on the street, and visitors can take photos with them, or experience the Japanese tea ceremony, Edo period food, etc.

globaltix_product_data.description: The Early Access to the Acropolis & Parthenon Walking Tour is a guided cultural experience in Athens, Greece, offering visitors the rare opportunity to explore the world-famous Acropolis before peak crowds arrive. This small-group tour provides a more intimate and शांत experience of one of the most iconic UNESCO World Heritage Sites, allowing guests to fully appreciate its history, architecture, and breathtaking views. Led by a professional licensed guide, guests will explore the Acropolis complex, including the Parthenon, Temple of Athena Nike, Erechtheion, and Propylaea gateway. Along the way, the guide shares fascinating stories of ancient Greek mythology, history, and architecture, bringing the ancient citadel to life. Visitors will also see the Theater of Dionysus and Odeon of Herodes Atticus while enjoying panoramic views over Athens. The experience lasts approximately 2 hours and operates on a fixed timeslot schedule, typically in the early morning. Guests meet at a designated point before entering the site with early access and skip-the-line benefits (security checks still apply). The tour follows a structured walking route, with some free time at the end for photos and independent exploration.

Discover ancient Greek history and mythology with a professional guide in a small-group setting.
Perfect for couples, solo travelers, and small groups looking for a premium cultural experience.

globaltix_product_data.description: To truly understand the natural world, you've got to understand the smallest and most successful organisms: microbes. Tiny, powerful and invisible to the human eye, microbes are absolutely fascinating. Especially when presented like this. Acclaimed as the most innovative and groundbreaking museum in Europe (2016 European Museum of the Year Awards).Micropia is the world's first microbe museum, and by making these invisible creatures visible, it shows the interconnectedness of all things, and gives some surprising insights into the way the world works.Did you know that two-thirds of the total number of species on earth are invisible to the naked eye? These creatures also live in some surprising places: on your tongue, under your arms, and on your skin. In fact, microbes can be found literally everywhere. And if that sounds gross, you definitely need to visit Micropia and get a new perspective on these creatures. Without micro-organisms such as fungi, yeasts, (micro)algae, bacteria, archaea, viruses and micro-creatures life on this planet it wouldn't be possible. And Micropia shows all the different ways that our lives, and the planet as a whole, interacts with and is influenced by these unseen creatures.When thought of at all, the common perception is that microbes make people sick. But that's just a small part of the story. Microbiology can offer solutions to global problems, including water purification and cures to infectious diseases. Microbes can produce energy, food and bio-plastics. By understanding microbes we can create new uses for them.And the best way to understand them is to immerse yourself in this innovative museum. Come and revel in the world of bacteria and germs!
highlights: From Actinomyces to Trichophyton rubrum, find out about the different types of microbes with a simulated body scan
Discover why ARTIS-Micropia was voted Europe's most innovative and groundbreaking museum at the 2016 European Museum of the Year Awards
Step into the Kiss-O-Meter and discover what happens to the microbes in your mouth during a kiss (or a sneeze)

globaltix_product_data.description: Head on over to Desaru Resort Waterpark with your family and friends, and prepare yourself for a splashingly good time! Explore the waterpark's five zones, each featuring different levels of rides. Explore a setting filled with intrigue, pirates, and young heroes at Penawar Falls. With the classic Swinging Ship and with multiple waterfalls tumbling over rising cliffs into a pond below, this zone is sure to capture the attention of both young and old alike. Ride along the long, looping, lazy Penawar River that floats amid the lush greenery of fishing village scenes and experience four giant water slides — the Wild Whirl, Super Twister, Riptide, and Temptest!

Check the official website of the Taiwanese Highway Administration for more details You may be denied from participating in the activity if you fail to present both your license and the official Japanese translation. No refund will be issued in this instance Fee Exclude: The customer will be responsible for any damage in excess of the amount of co-payment and the maximum amount of compensation mentioned above In the event of an accident that falls within the scope of events for which insurance payments cannot be made under the terms and conditions of the insurance policy, no compensation will be made If there is no proof of accident from the police, there may be no compensation What to wear: Please refrain from wearing clothes such as high heels and long skirts, which can hinder driving Additional information: We will provide you with more information about the documents required for kart rental after you make a reservation. If you do not have all the documents, you may not be able to rent a kart The facility provides cosplay costumes that participants can borrow for no extra charge. You can purchase inexpensive costumes at the nearby Don Quixote shop if you would like your own! The guide driver will serve as a guide for the entire group You need to have a international license in order to join this activity. globaltix_product_data.description: Albatross Hop-On Hop-Off Speedboat Pass (1-Day Unlimited Speedboat Rides)Singapore’s first and only hop-on hop-off speedboat experience. Experience Singapore’s southern coastline at your own pace with the Albatross Hop-On Hop-Off Speedboat Pass — a flexible 1-day pass that gives you unlimited rides, total freedom, and the thrill of exploring Singapore’s stunning Southern Islands by sea.Cruising 23 kilometres of scenic southern waters, this pass allows you to hop on and off our fast adventure vessel throughout the day. Start from Resorts World Sentosa or Ola Beach Club at Siloso Beach, and continue your journey at our island hop-on points at Lazarus Island, Kusu Island, and Sisters’ Islands. Whether you’re chasing excitement or seeking a relaxing coastal escape, this flexible experience lets you customise your perfect adventure. Admire iconic landmarks such as Dragon’s Teeth Gate, Lazarus Island, St. John’s Island, Kusu Island, Sisters’ Islands, and the majestic Singapore City Skyline — all from the comfort of a high-speed boat accommodating up to 50 passengers. Learn more about the iconic Singapore landmarks and the Singapore Story from the engaging and informative audio commentary throughout the cruise.Complimentary raincoats and bottled water are available upon request, ensuring comfort throughout your journey.Boats operate on a continuous loop throughout the day — simply return to any hop-on point to rejoin the cruise at your convenience.Feel the sea breeze, ride the waves, and discover hidden gems across Singapore’s Southern Islands — all on your own schedule with the Albatross Hop-On Hop-Off Speedboat Pass. Visit Us Address: Albatross Ticket Booth - Address: 8 Sentosa Gateway, Singapore 098269 (Adjacent to Singapore Oceanarium) 46 Siloso Beach Walk, Sentosa Island, Singapore 099005 www.olabeachclub.com
highlights: Unlimited hop-on hop-off rides for one day
Island stops: Lazarus, Kusu & Sisters’ Islands
Comfortable 50-passenger high-speed boat, Perfect for families, couples & adventurers
Boarding points: Resorts World Sentosa & Ola Beach Club (Siloso Beach)
Stunning views of Dragon’s Teeth Gate, southern coastline & Singapore skyline
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Duration: 1 Day Pass – Unlimited rides during operating hours Route: Approximately 23 km of Singapore’s southern coastline, covering Resorts World Sentosa and Ola Beach Club (Siloso Beach) Vessel Capacity: Up to 50 passengers Suitable for ages 4 and above and below 130KG How It Works: Start Your Adventure – Board the Albatross Speedboat from Resorts World Sentosa or Ola Beach Club at Siloso Beach. Hop Off to Explore – Disembark at Ola Beach Club (Siloso Beach) to enjoy the beach and nearby attractions. Hop Back On Anytime – Rejoin the adventure as many times as you like throughout the day. End Your Journey – Return to Resorts World Sentosa or Ola Beach Club before the last sail. Life jackets provided for all guests. Bring sunscreen, sunglasses, and light clothing. Operating hours and departure schedules may vary depending on weather and sea conditions.

options.description: Resorts World Sentosa to Ola Beach Club & Back to Resorts World Sentosa or Ola Beach Club to Resorts World Sentosa & Back to Ola Beach Club Choose the Albatross Hop-on Hop-off Speedboat Return Trip Ticket for an enjoyable and time-saving coastal loop experience. This ticket gives you the flexibility to travel from your starting point to the destination, and then hop back onto the speedboat anytime within the operating hours to return to your original location. You can board our comfortable vessel from either Resorts World Sentosa or Ola Beach Club, experience a pleasant ride across the water, and return effortlessly when you are ready. It's the perfect option if you need efficient, guaranteed transport back and want to enjoy a quick, water-based viewing experience. This round-trip cruise along the Sentosa shore provides clear, unique views of the island's waterfront. You’ll see the impressive scale of Resorts World Sentosa and scenic landmarks like the historic Long Ya Men (Dragon's Tooth Gate) at Labrador Park and the lively Siloso Beachfront. Secure your return trip now for a simple, round-trip transfer that brings you back smoothly and refreshed, whenever you choose to return. Complimentary raincoats and bottled water are available upon request. Stops include Lazarus, Kusu and Sisters’ Islands, with scenic views of Dragon’s Teeth Gate, the southern coastline and Singapore skyline aboard a comfortable 50-passenger high-speed boat—ideal for families, couples and adventurers. Pickup/Meeting Point: Sentosa Gateway, S.E.A. Aquarium, Sentosa Island, Singapore Important Information This ticket is valid starting from 12th December 2025 NEW ALBATROSS HOHO VIDEO Please refer to the LINK for the detail Youtube: https://youtu.be/-jYVP5MzN_w?si=olkX8uNe2oJIyRyb Operating hours: 12 pm to 6 pm (Hourly sails), 7 days a week Duration: 1 Day Pass - Unlimited rides during operating hours Route Approximately 23 km of Singapore’s southern coastline, covering Resorts World Sentosa and Ola Beach Club (Siloso Beach) Vessel Capacity Up to 50 passengers Suitable For Ages 4 and above Good to Know Life jackets provided for all guests. Bring sunscreen, sunglasses, and light clothing. Operating hours and departure schedules may vary depending on weather and sea conditions. How long does the cruise take? RWS–OBC or OBC–RWS --- Approximately 15 minutes (single hop). RWS–OBC–RWS or OBC–RWS–OBC --- Approximately 30 minutes (two single hops). OBC–Southern Islands–OBC --- Approximately 1 hour (round trip). RWS–OBC–Southern Islands–OBC–RWS --- Approximately 1 hour (Round Trip) RWS–RWS (Non‐Stop) --- Approximately 1 hour (round trip). 12 pm to 6 pm (Hourly sails), 7 days a week Boarding and hop-off points include: RWS (adjacent to Singapore Oceanarium exit) Ola Beach Club, Siloso Beach Lazarus Island Kusu Island Sisters’ Islands Note: RWS = Resorts World Sentosa OBC = Ola Beach Club SI = Southern Islands (Lazarus, Kusu, Sisters) NEW TALL SHIP CAFE NEW TALL SHIP CAFÉ MENU NEW TALL SHIP CAFÉ will be open 7 days a week, From 11 am to 3 pm on sailing days, and 11 am to 5 pm on non-sailing days. Last orders will be 30 minutes before published closing time. NEW TALL SHIP CAFÉ will continue to curate a unique lunch time dining experience, for locals and international tourists who love dining on the water with stunning 360 sea views and instagramable Harbourfront views. We strongly encourage all visitors to check the most up-to-date information on the website (https://www.tallship.com.sg/tallship-cafe/) prior to visit.
options.termsAndConditions: This ticket are valid for 3 months from the date of purchase, and prices are not guaranteed until the ticket is issued. Children under 8 years old must sit in the middle row between adults, wear the provided life jacket, and their parents must sign a waiver. Children between 8 and 12 years old are also recommended to sit in the middle row between adults and must be supervised by a responsible adult at a ratio of at least 1 adult to 2 children at all times. Footwear: Suitable flat, non-marking footwear must be worn. Operating hours: 12:00 PM – 6:00 PM, with hourly sailings, 7 days a week. Sailing times and routes are subject to weather, sea conditions, and operational requirements. Guests may board the next available boat without prior reservation. Average waiting time is under 30 minutes. Children are permitted; however, it is recommended that they are at least 4 years old. Younger children may travel subject to a signed liability waiver and compliance with safety requirements. Life jackets (including child sizes), life rings, and flotation devices are provided onboard. Maximum capacity: up to 50 passengers per boat. All vessels are licensed as Singapore Passenger Harbour Craft (SP) under the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore. Operations continue in rainy weather. In the event of expected thunderstorms or unsafe conditions, the Captain may suspend sailings until conditions improve. The ride is generally smooth; however, occasional bumps may occur due to vessel wakes and sea conditions. Guests who are prone to motion sickness are advised to take appropriate medication prior to boarding. Boats do not have toilet facilities. Guests are advised to use nearby restrooms before boarding. Guests may experience light splashes depending on seating and weather; complimentary raincoats are available upon request. Music and videos about local landmarks may be played during the cruise. Pets are not permitted onboard. Smoking is strictly prohibited on all vessels.Eligibility: The Cruise is NOT recommended for individuals who are: Over 130 kilograms (286 pounds) in weight. Have serious medical conditions. Children under 8 years of age. Elderly individuals. Expectant mothers.More t&c please refer: https://speedboat.sg/terms-conditions/

Albatross Hop-On Hop-Off Speedboat Pass

 

Important Information

Youtube: https://youtu.be/-jYVP5MzN_w?si=olkX8uNe2oJIyRyb

 

Operating hours: 

  • 12 pm to 6 pm (Hourly sails), 7 days a week

Duration:

  • 1 Day Pass - Unlimited rides during operating hours

Route

  • Approximately 23 km of Singapore’s southern coastline, covering Resorts World Sentosa and Ola Beach Club (Siloso Beach)

Vessel Capacity

  • Up to 50 passengers

Suitable For

  • Ages 4 and above

Good to Know

  • Life jackets provided for all guests. Bring sunscreen, sunglasses, and light clothing. Operating hours and departure schedules may vary depending on weather and sea conditions.

How long does the cruise take?

  • RWS–OBC or OBC–RWS --- Approximately 15 minutes (single hop).
  • RWS–OBC–RWS or OBC–RWS–OBC --- Approximately 30 minutes (two single hops).
  • OBC–Southern Islands–OBC --- Approximately 1 hour (round trip).
  • RWS–OBC–Southern Islands–OBC–RWS --- Approximately 1 hour (Round Trip)
  • RWS–RWS (Non‐Stop) --- Approximately 1 hour (round trip). 12 pm to 6 pm (Hourly sails), 7 days a week

Boarding and hop-off points include:

  • RWS (adjacent to Singapore Oceanarium exit)
  • Ola Beach Club, Siloso Beach
  • Lazarus Island
  • Kusu Island
  • Sisters’ Islands

Note: 

  • RWS = Resorts World Sentosa
  • OBC = Ola Beach Club
  • SI = Southern Islands (Lazarus, Kusu, Sisters)

Universal Studios Singapore

 

Guests are required to visit the official website for the latest operating hours: Please refer Here

 

Important Notice:

Ride closures for maintenance:

  • Waterworld: closed till further notice
  • Battlestar Galactica: HUMAN vs. CYLON will be temporarily closed for maintenance from 4 May 2026 to 5 July 2026 and will reopen on 6 July 2026.
  • Treasure Hunters will be temporarily closed for maintenance from 12 May 2026 to 20 May 2026 and will reopen on 21 May 2026.
  • All other attractions and shows will continue to operate as scheduled. Attraction availability is subject to change without prior notice.
  • For more updated information, please visit Top Attraction – USS Universal Studios Singapore (Official). Rides operation will be updated on RWS website on affected days.

globaltix_product_data.description: Alcazar Co., Ltd. or broadly known as Alcazar Cabaret, was established on November 8th, 1981. Originally, with about 100 performer and staff, the former Alcazar's theater had a capacity of only 350 seats which were not enough to welcome domestic and foreign visitors. Therefore, our new, grand and modern architectural theater with state-of-the-art light and sound systems and capacity of about 1,200 seats has opened its doors for visitors from all over the world since February 9th, 1990. Nowadays, "Alcazar" is globally famous with the reputation of the best transvestite cabaret show in Thailand. Continuously, we have improved our show employing modern technology of stage arts for serving our visitors, Each year, our creative show production team works extremely hard together with million of Thai baht are spent for creating and presenting impressive show to our visitors' eyes.
highlights: World-Class Cabaret Show – Experience one of Pattaya’s most famous cabaret performances featuring dazzling costumes, music, and theatrical choreography.
Spectacular Stage Production – Enjoy high-tech lighting, vibrant stage sets, and dynamic performances inspired by cultures from around the world.
Talented Performers – Watch skilled transgender artists deliver polished dance routines and engaging musical acts.
Immersive Entertainment – Be captivated by colorful visuals, lively music, and storytelling that bring each performance to life.
Iconic Pattaya Experience – A must-see nightlife attraction offering a memorable cultural and entertainment show for visitors of all ages.

globaltix_product_data.name: Private Alhambra and Generalife with Nasrid Palaces
globaltix_product_data.summary: The Private Alhambra and Generalife with Nasrid Palaces tour is the most comprehensive and exclusively intimate private experience available at one of the world's most extraordinary architectural ensembles — the UNESCO World Heritage complex in Granada that represents the supreme achievement of medi...
globaltix_product_data.description: The Private Alhambra and Generalife with Nasrid Palaces tour is the most comprehensive and exclusively intimate private experience available at one of the world's most extraordinary architectural ensembles — the UNESCO World Heritage complex in Granada that represents the supreme achievement of medieval Islamic architecture in Europe, experienced with a dedicated expert Amigo Tours guide for your group alone and with guaranteed access to the strictly capacity-controlled Nasrid Palaces. The private format allows the guide to navigate the full complexity of the Alhambra's layered history and architectural richness at a pace and with a depth of historical, artistic, and cultural commentary entirely tailored to your group's specific interests. The Nasrid Palaces — the jewel of the Alhambra complex, accessible only through timed entry tickets of strictly limited availability — provide the experience's most overwhelming and emotionally powerful chapter. The Mexuar, Comares, and Lions Palace sections each contain spaces of almost incomprehensible decorative beauty — the Court of the Lions with its alabaster fountain and its surrounding arcade of 124 slender columns supporting the most technically accomplished carved stucco vaulting in the history of Islamic architecture providing the single most celebrated interior space in Spain. The Generalife summer palace and its tiered garden terraces, and the Alcazaba fortress with its tower views across Granada and the Sierra Nevada, complete an experience of extraordinary depth and lasting beauty.

globaltix_product_data.description: Spanning across four storeys, the 2,800sqm Adventure HQ features 10 kaleidoscopic adventure installations, catering to all levels of adrenaline thrills. - The Bouldering Wall allows participants to test and practise both their balance and agility skills with little to no equipment in a safe and interactive environment. - The Rock Climb boasts 8 different climbing lanes, serving as an adrenaline canvas for climbers of all levels. Participants can expect to clock in the ultimate body workout, safely with the help of our trained personels. - Suitable for both the young and the young at heart, our very own Ninja Course is the perfect place to improve one's strength, endurance, coordination, and agility. - Fossil Labyrinth, a realistic Artificial Caving experience, challenges participants in a labyrinth of dark tunnels with stalacities, stalagmites, sumps, fossils and other speleo features - Being Singapore's biggest two-tiered Indoor Challenge Ropes Course, the 15m standing Sky Venture provides participants with a multi-sensorial experience helping them develop their balancing skills, self-confidence, hand-eye coordination, and observation skills - The Adventure Trail boasts challenging tunnels of nets and obstacles alongside other uniquely designed ariel elements - Our Firemen Slides come in 3 different forms, one of which hosts Singapore's Longest Indoor Slide at 14m! (4.5 storeys high) - Being the first and newest indoor aerial attraction in Singapore, the Roll Glider offers the adventure experience of hang-gliding, a coaster ride and proximity flight in a safe and accessible environment. Adventure HQ is a SG Clean certified establishment.

Participants can test their physical and mental limits by taking on a variety of thrilling challenges and obstacles at Adventure HQ.
Adventure HQ caters to families looking to bond and create lasting memories together.

globaltix_product_data.description: Inclusions Hotel pick-up and drop-off by 4x4 1-hour camel ride Bedouin-style camping Sand boarding Henna painting Sheesha Belly dance Tanoura dance Haridi dance BBQ dinner buffet Moderate cancellation policy What to Expect On this stunning desert safari, you will have the opportunity to partake in a desert caravan where you get to ride camels for one hour and experience the mode of traveling that has been used by people since the early days Head over to a Bedouin camp and experience a wide variety of desert activities such as sand boarding, henna hand painting and sheesha smoking Be entertained as dancers present a show of Belly dances, Tanoura dance and Haridi dance Satiate yourself with a delicious buffet meal under the desert sky The Ride Get picked up from your hotel in a 4x4 and head out to the Arabian Desert leaving the city behind. Be amazed at the sudden change of scenery as the buildings give way to sand and rocks. The scenery is truly unique and stunning. Camel Riding Camels have been given many names. Amongst them are the Rolls Royce of the desert and the ship of the desert . Their abilities to travel far distances for a long time without food and water made these wonderful creatures an indelible part of the Arabic tradition. You will be able to experience a traditional, caravan-style ride across the desert aboard a camel. Experience how people in the early days crossed the deserts to travel between emirates on camels before you head over to a Bedouin camp. The Camp After the camel ride, you arrive at a traditional Bedouin camp where other desert activities await you. Here, you will be able to experience such as sand boarding, henna hand painting and shisha smoking. There will also be a host of pretty and talented dancers adding excitement to an already fun-packed evening with traditional fire shows, Tanoura, belly dancing and a Haridi dance. The Dinner As the day comes to a close, you will be led to a delectable barbecue buffet prepared under the stars. With a wide array of vegetarian and non-vegetarian dishes to choose from, your buffet will be the perfect end to your evening.
highlights: Looking for the ultimate all-inclusive luxury overnight desert Dubai safari? Grab these premium overnight safari tickets with return transfers!
Revel in a dune bashing and sandboarding experience in the Arabian desert.
Take a camel ride through the dunes of the Arabian desert, and admire the incredible landscape around you.
Delight in a scrumptious barbecue buffet dinner, with a spread of local delicacies and international cuisines, fit for a king!
Spend the night in the desert at the Al Khayma Camp in a typical Bedouin style, watch entertaining traditional performances and sleep in a comfortable tent.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Ambassador Transit Lounge – Terminal 2 is located airside within Changi Airport, Terminal 2, Departure Transit area. Access is via the escalator near Changi Airport - Terminal 2, Transit Lounge South, near Transfer F, on the 3rd Floor, next to Dreamscape Attractions. The Transit Lounge offers hourly...
globaltix_product_data.description: Ambassador Transit Lounge – Terminal 2 is located airside within Changi Airport, Terminal 2, Departure Transit area. Access is via the escalator near Changi Airport - Terminal 2, Transit Lounge South, near Transfer F, on the 3rd Floor, next to Dreamscape Attractions. The Transit Lounge offers hourly lounge access, providing a comfortable space to sit and relax, along with food and beverages, shower facilities, and Wi-Fi. Lounge access is available for 3-hour, 5-hour, and 10-hour durations. Guests are advised to check the specified duration for each booking option. IMPORTANT NOTICE: As the lounge is located airside in the Restricted/Transit area, transit travelers must NOT clear immigration or customs. This means that only passengers transiting through Singapore—traveling to another country without clearing Singapore’s arrival immigration—can access the lounge. • Arriving passengers planning to enter Singapore cannot stay at the Ambassador Transit Lounge – Terminal 2. • Departing passengers from the city should note that most airline check-in counters open only 3 hours before departure. Access to the transit area is not permitted earlier unless early check-in is available with your airline. If you need assistance upon arrival, our 24-hour front desk is available to help with luggage collection, onward boarding passes, and re-entering the transit area.
highlights: Relax, refresh & recharge at Changi’s Ambassador Transit Lounge (Airside) – enjoy dining, showers & Wi-Fi
Ideal for transit and departing guests.
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Ambassador Transit Lounge – Terms & Conditions 1. Access & Eligibility Lounge access is available only to passengers transiting through Singapore Changi Airport with a valid same-day departure boarding pass. Guests must comply with airport security and immigration regulations. 2. Booking & Usage Lounge access can be purchased via walk-in, online pre-booking, travel agents, or airline partners. Usage is based on the selected duration (e.g., 3-hour, 5-hour, 10-hour packages) Extensions are subject to availability and additional charges. Pre-booked reservations are non-transferable and valid only for the specified date and time. 3. Lounge Facilities & Services Buffet dining, Wi-Fi, and shower facilities are included in standard lounge access. Nap rooms, spa treatments, and additional services may require separate bookings and fees. Lounge seating is available on a first-come, first-served basis; reserved seating is not provided. 4. Conduct & Etiquette Guests must maintain respectful behavior; disruptive conduct may result in removal from the lounge without a refund. The lounge is a shared space—please be mindful of noise levels and other guests. 5. Children & Family Policy Children are welcome; age-based pricing may apply. Infants under 2 years old may enter free of charge with an accompanying adult. 6. Cancellations & Refunds Refunds or changes are not permitted for no-shows or missed reservations. In case of flight delays or cancellations, requests for adjustments will be handled on a case-by-case basis. 7. Liability Disclaimer The lounge operator is not responsible for lost or unattended belongings. Lounge access does not include airline boarding announcements; guests must monitor their flight schedules. The company reserves the right to modify services, pricing, or policies without prior notice.

globaltix_product_data.description: Ambassador Transit Lounge – Terminal 2 is located airside within Changi Airport, Terminal 2, Departure Transit area. Access is via the escalator near Changi Airport - Terminal 2, Transit Lounge South, near Transfer F, on the 3rd Floor, next to Dreamscape Attractions. The Transit Lounge offers hourly lounge access, providing a comfortable space to sit and relax, along with food and beverages, shower facilities, and Wi-Fi. Lounge access is available for 3-hour, 5-hour, and 10-hour durations. Guests are advised to check the specified duration for each booking option. IMPORTANT NOTICE: As the lounge is located airside in the Restricted/Transit area, transit travelers must NOT clear immigration or customs. This means that only passengers transiting through Singapore—traveling to another country without clearing Singapore’s arrival immigration—can access the lounge. • Arriving passengers planning to enter Singapore cannot stay at the Ambassador Transit Lounge – Terminal 2. • Departing passengers from the city should note that most airline check-in counters open only 3 hours before departure. Access to the transit area is not permitted earlier unless early check-in is available with your airline. If you need assistance upon arrival, our 24-hour front desk is available to help with luggage collection, onward boarding passes, and re-entering the transit area.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Three million square feet under one roof in the New Jersey Meadowlands, twenty minutes from Manhattan, containing things that have no business being indoors — including a real snow ski slope that runs all year, whatever the weather outside. Big SNOW is the oddest and best of it: a genuine groomed pi...
globaltix_product_data.description: Three million square feet under one roof in the New Jersey Meadowlands, twenty minutes from Manhattan, containing things that have no business being indoors — including a real snow ski slope that runs all year, whatever the weather outside. Big SNOW is the oddest and best of it: a genuine groomed piste, cold enough for jackets, with lifts, rentals and instructors. Alongside sit Nickelodeon Universe, an indoor theme park with roller coasters looping through the atrium, and DreamWorks Water Park, where a wave pool and dozens of slides sit under a glass ceiling at a permanent summer temperature. Then there is everything else — a SEA LIFE aquarium, a LEGO Discovery Center, a full-size ice rink, mini golf, a cinema, a three-hundred-foot observation wheel on the roof, and several hundred shops and restaurants threaded between them.
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Rules and regulations 1. Do not leave your belongings unattended while riding. 2. Riding rules vary. Please check the signs at the entrance. 3. Children under 14 years old must be accompanied by a guardian. 4. Guardians must be at least 14 years old and capable of assisting children in following instructions. Terms & Conditions 1. The admission ticket is only valid for Nickelodeon Universe. Our park's opening hours vary daily, so please check your admission ticket confirmation for planning your visit. The admission ticket is only valid for Nickelodeon Universe. Admission tickets are not transferable between attractions and must be purchased separately for each park attraction. 2. To obtain boarding rights, all passengers must hold a valid NICKELODEON UNIVERSE PASS. 3. Wristbands cannot be shared, transferred, or resold. Wristbands do not grant access to the "Hidden Temple Legend" ropes course challenge or any closed rides or attractions. 4. For inquiries about your admission ticket, please visit any of our customer service points. All rides, slides, and attractions have height and weight restrictions. 5. The admission ticket is only valid on the specified purchase date and time. Tickets are non-transferable and non-refundable. 6. The park's opening hours, admission ticket types, availability, and prices are subject to change without prior notice. This admission ticket is not valid for special or private activities. globaltix_product_data.description: Three million square feet under one roof in the New Jersey Meadowlands, twenty minutes from Manhattan, containing things that have no business being indoors — including a real snow ski slope that runs all year, whatever the weather outside. Big SNOW is the oddest and best of it: a genuine groomed piste, cold enough for jackets, with lifts, rentals and instructors. Alongside sit Nickelodeon Universe, an indoor theme park with roller coasters looping through the atrium, and DreamWorks Water Park, where a wave pool and dozens of slides sit under a glass ceiling at a permanent summer temperature. Then there is everything else — a SEA LIFE aquarium, a LEGO Discovery Center, a full-size ice rink, mini golf, a cinema, a three-hundred-foot observation wheel on the roof, and several hundred shops and restaurants threaded between them.

globaltix_product_data.description: The Amsterdam 75 Minute City Canal Cruise with Audio Guide is a relaxing sightseeing experience that takes you through the city’s iconic UNESCO-listed canal network. Located in Amsterdam, Netherlands, this scenic boat tour offers a unique perspective of the city’s historic waterways, allowing visitors to admire charming canal houses, picturesque bridges, and famous landmarks from the water. As you cruise along the canals, you’ll pass highlights such as the Anne Frank House, Westerkerk, and the elegant 17th-century canal belt, while enjoying informative audio commentary available in multiple languages. The audio guide shares fascinating stories, history, and local insights, enhancing the overall sightseeing experience for both adults and children. The experience lasts approximately 75 minutes and operates on a fixed schedule with multiple departure times throughout the day. Guests can board from several central locations, present mobile or printed tickets for easy entry, and enjoy a smooth, comfortable cruise with optional upgrades such as snack boxes and drinks.

options.description: Riverine Splash is a tribal-themed waterpark set within a lush, nature-inspired landscape, offering fun and exciting rides for visitors of all ages. Designed for both relaxation and adventure, the park provides a refreshing escape for families and groups looking to enjoy a day of water activities. Thrill seekers can get their adrenaline pumping on the exciting Boa and Anaconda Tube slides, while those looking to unwind can take a relaxing float along the Rimba River and enjoy the surrounding sights and sounds of nature. Riverine Splash is the perfect destination for a fun-filled and memorable family outing. Operating hours: Mon, Wed & Thu: 11:00 AM – 5:00 PM Fri–Sun, Public Holidays & School Holidays: 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM Closed every Tuesday (except Public Holidays) What to Bring / Preparation Swimwear and a change of dry clothes (especially for the water park) Sunscreen — the sun is strong here, so don't skip it Comfortable walking shoes for activity areas Water bottle and light snacks Golfers: bring your own clubs or arrange rental in advance Cash — most facilities within the resort (water park, mini zoo, activity parks) are chargeable separately, so bring enough budget How To Get There Address: PT 673, Jalan Pulau Carey, Mukim Jugra, 42960 Pulau Carey, Selangor. By Car (Recommended): Drive from KL city centre towards Teluk Panglima Garang via the Klang-Banting road. From Teluk Panglima Garang, narrow roads take you past rustic Malay villages to Carey Island. A two-lane bridge via the SKVE at Teluk Panglima Garang connects the island to the mainland. The drive takes about an hour from KL. Visit SelangorThe Island Drum By Public Transport + Grab: There is no public transport that goes directly to Pulau Carey. You can take the KTM Komuter to Klang Station (not Port Klang), then take a Grab to Amverton Cove for approximately RM35. globaltix_product_data.description: There's so much to see at this huge outdoor complex, you'll feel like you've ticked off all of Thailand's best bits within a day. Take a stroll around the impressive site and explore smaller versions of Thailand's famous temples, palaces, gardens, floating markets, and much more. There are five park zones to explore, covering different areas of Thailand and a combination of traditional and modern buildings. As you explore, you'll learn all about the history of the country, soak up the unique Ancient City atmosphere, and discover new and traditional cultures, architecture, and arts.

globaltix_product_data.name: Page: Lower Antelope Canyon Tour with Trained Navajo Guide
globaltix_product_data.summary: Explore the sandstone slopes of Lower Antelope Canyon in Page, Arizona on a guided hike. Join a professional Navajo guide as you set out to wander along the orange-hued canyon.
globaltix_product_data.description: Explore the sandstone slopes of Lower Antelope Canyon in Page, Arizona on a guided hike. Join a professional Navajo guide as you set out to wander along the orange-hued canyon.
highlights: Visit a favorite gathering place for photographers and nature enthusiasts
Enjoy peace of mind thanks to emergency ladders and other safety measures
Benefit from the knowledge and experience of an expert Navajo guide
Watch the shifting shapes as the sunlight bounces against canyon walls
Experience the Lower Antelope Canyon in Page on a guided hiking tour
exclusions: Tips for your guide (minimum of $5.00/person recommended)
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: The duration of the tour is ~1.5 hours, including 30 minutes of check-in time. There are steel ladders anchored into the canyon walls. The ladders vary from 3 ft to 25 ft in length. Ladders over 8 ft. have handrails in place. The canyon is easily accessible, going in and out. There are escape rope ladders placed in metal boxes on top of the canyon in case of an emergency. No pets or animals are allowed into the canyon: to respect our guests who are allergic to dogs, cats, and other animals, we request that you not bring your pets and/or animals into the canyon. We abide by strict rules and regulations to protect and preserve the canyon. The speed at which people move through the canyon is outside of the local operator's control. If planning another activity following this tour, please leave an extra 1-2 hours after this tour during peak times.

globaltix_product_data.description: Departing right in front of SEA LIFE Sunshine Coast, the Aquaduck Tour offers the perfect blend of city sightseeing and river cruising, all aboard one incredible amphibious vehicle. On land, you'll take in the stunning landscapes of Mooloolaba Beach, the Esplanade, and Sunshine Strip, soaking in the vibrant coastal scenery before experiencing the famous "splash down" as your vehicle transitions seamlessly from land to water. Once cruising, admire the natural beauty of the Mooloolah River as you wind through scenic canals and waterways, marvelling at the magnificent homes and opulent mansions belonging to the region's rich and famous. Along the way, knowledgeable guides bring the journey to life with fascinating stories covering the area's indigenous heritage, early settlement history, vibrant beach culture, and the diverse wildlife that calls this stretch of coastline home. Adding to the fun, children are invited to take the helm of the Aquaduck and receive their very own souvenir captain's certificate to commemorate the experience. With a perfect mix of landscapes, wildlife, and waterways, this unforgettable adventure is designed to create lasting memories for the whole family. Hop aboard and let the friendly guides take you on a journey through the very heart of the Sunshine Coast.

globaltix_product_data.summary: The Paris Aquarium (also known as Cinéaqua) is a world class festival of the sea. globaltix_product_data.description: The Paris Aquarium (also known as Cinéaqua) is a world class festival of the sea. One of the oldest aquariums in the world - it was built in 1867 -, it has more than 10,000 creatures who call its depths home. Featuring mermaid shows, an aquatic cinema and a shark basin stacked with the apex predators, this is an incredible way to add a deep blue dimension to your trip to the center of Paris.The Paris Aquarium embodies the late-19th-century passion for scientific exploration. Every major city had to have an aquarium, and as Europe’s leading urban light, Paris's had to be the best. Decorated like it stepped out of Jules Verne's , this particular bowl of fishes is as rich with history as it is in aquatic life. 10,000 fish swim in 4 million liters of water, with tanks holding aquatic life from far-flung tropical locales, as well as from closer to home. In fact, the first section is full of carp, sturgeon and roach swimming in a re-creation of the nearby Seine.The recreated seas of Tahiti and New Caledonia swarm with fish of all colors: angel, clown and triggerfish jockey for position, as they dart among rock and coral. The scale is awe-inspiring; it’s not surprising that this was once Europe’s largest aquarium.The show stealers, however, are the sharks. Four species of these predators of the deep never fail to elicit squeals from the kids, and nervous laughter from everyone else. The aquarium also has two large screens that show aquatic documentaries, live feeding demonstrations, and a touchtank, where kids can get their hands on some slippery ornamental fish. At the end of your visit you'll emerge into one of the most beautiful parts of the city. Eiffel Tower at your elbow, the Champs-Élysées at your back, and the whole city at your fingertips. Off you go, there's more to explore.
highlights: Vast tanks display more than 13,000 aquatic creatures, coming from as far as Tahiti, and as close to right next to you in the Seine!
Great for the kid in all of us. You get to touch fish and also see mermaids swimming among the other fish to blow little minds wide open
Get in touch with marine life at the Aquarium de Paris petting pond, where you can stroke ornamental fish that seem to find the experience quite pleasant
inclusions: Access to the Cinema area and Educational Animations

globaltix_product_data.description: Compact enough to cover comfortably in an afternoon, this SeaWorld water park has one attraction that nowhere else in Texas can offer. Stingray Falls sends your raft through darkness and out into a grotto where rays and tropical fish swim behind glass on both sides of you. Around it sit the bigger thrills — Walhalla Wave and HooRoo Run for four-person rafts, Taumata Racer for head-first mat racing, and a set of tube and body slides — along with a wave pool that switches between gentle swell and something more energetic. Two rivers circle the site for drifting, and shallow zones at Walkabout Waters and Kata's Kookaburra Cove give small children slides and fountains of their own. Palms and sand give the whole park a resort feel rather than a municipal one.

globaltix_product_data.description: Compact enough to cover comfortably in an afternoon, this SeaWorld water park has one attraction that nowhere else in Texas can offer. Stingray Falls sends your raft through darkness and out into a grotto where rays and tropical fish swim behind glass on both sides of you. Around it sit the bigger thrills — Walhalla Wave and HooRoo Run for four-person rafts, Taumata Racer for head-first mat racing, and a set of tube and body slides — along with a wave pool that switches between gentle swell and something more energetic. Two rivers circle the site for drifting, and shallow zones at Walkabout Waters and Kata's Kookaburra Cove give small children slides and fountains of their own. Palms and sand give the whole park a resort feel rather than a municipal one.

globaltix_product_data.description: Compact enough to cover comfortably in an afternoon, this SeaWorld water park has one attraction that nowhere else in Texas can offer. Stingray Falls sends your raft through darkness and out into a grotto where rays and tropical fish swim behind glass on both sides of you. Around it sit the bigger thrills — Walhalla Wave and HooRoo Run for four-person rafts, Taumata Racer for head-first mat racing, and a set of tube and body slides — along with a wave pool that switches between gentle swell and something more energetic. Two rivers circle the site for drifting, and shallow zones at Walkabout Waters and Kata's Kookaburra Cove give small children slides and fountains of their own. Palms and sand give the whole park a resort feel rather than a municipal one.

globaltix_product_data.summary: The Arc de Triomphe is a Neoclassical take on the ancient Roman triumphal arch style. Fifty meters tall, the view from the platform atop the arch is well worth the hike. See the dozen Parisian avenues radiating out from the arch into the City of Light. Paris is one of the most fascinating places in...
globaltix_product_data.description: The Arc de Triomphe is a Neoclassical take on the ancient Roman triumphal arch style. Fifty meters tall, the view from the platform atop the arch is well worth the hike. See the dozen Parisian avenues radiating out from the arch into the City of Light. Paris is one of the most fascinating places in the world and you will find yourself right at its center. Inspired by the great arches of ancient Rome, Napoleon commissioned the Arc de Triomphe shortly after his victory at Austerlitz. Unfortunately, he never lived to see its completion. At the base of the arch, the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier pays tribute to the 1.3 million French soldiers who died in World War I. Behold the eternal flame that is rekindled at 6.30 PM each evening. In addition, there is a must-see exhibition that explains the symbolic importance of this monument. The view from the top of the arch is worth climbing the 284 stairs. From your privileged position, survey all of Paris. Unlike the obligatory Eiffel Tower trip, getting into the Arc de Triomphe is an effort not all tourists undertake. Please note that the elevator is strictly for disabled people.
highlights: Relish the best panoramic view of Paris
See the tomb of the Unknown Soldier
Gain access to the top of the breathtaking Arc de Triomphe
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Due to safety measures, all visitors must comply with security checks. There may be long lines in the peak season. Kindly note that the elevator at the Arc de Triomphe is temporarily out of service. (The elevator to the top is reserved for disabled customers. The elevator travels to the shop level, and there are still 50 steps to access the rooftop) Entrance is free for those under 18 and EU citizens who are under 26 (presentation of picture ID at the ticketing station before going to the entrance) This ticket cannot be used to gain entry during special exhibitions Closed on January 1, May 1, May 8 (morning), July 14 (morning), November 11 (morning), and December 25 Last access is 45 minutes before closing Due to official ceremonies, the Arc de Triomphe may be closed exceptionally Free entrance is available on the first Sunday of January, February, March, November, and December and during European Heritage Days

globaltix_product_data.name: Arsenal Stadium Tour
globaltix_product_data.summary: Revel in a behind-the-scenes experience at the home of one of the most successful English football clubs in history, Arsenal. Get a chance to walk in the shoes of legends such as Arsene Wenger, Thierry Henry and Dennis Bergkamp. End your tour on a high note with a visit to the renowned Arsenal Museu...
globaltix_product_data.description: Revel in a behind-the-scenes experience at the home of one of the most successful English football clubs in history, Arsenal. Get a chance to walk in the shoes of legends such as Arsene Wenger, Thierry Henry and Dennis Bergkamp. End your tour on a high note with a visit to the renowned Arsenal Museum. Grab the chance to tour one of the most successful football clubs in history, guaranteed to be an unforgettable experience for all football fans. Experience the stadium as the players do! Visit the Press Room and feel the tension Arsenal managers would while being bombarded with questions by journalists and fans. Make your way through the horseshoe-shaped dressing rooms where the players would go over their strategies pre-match and celebrate their victories post-match. As you stroll through the player's tunnel, it is easy to envision the likes of Mesut Özil, Thierry Henry or Dennis Bergkamp walking alongside you! You will finally come upon the renowned pitch of the Emirates Stadium, and you will quickly understand why it is considered one of the best-kept grounds in the world! Sensational views of the entire stadium are visible from here, and you too can experience the feeling of sitting in the player's dugout and watching a match unfold. At the end of the tour, you will visit the Arsenal Museum, where you can see the trophy cabinet. Some of their greatest footballing triumphs have been immortalized here. A souvenir store is located next to the stadium, where you can buy signed memorabilia and merchandise. Getting There By Underground Take the Northern line to King's Cross St. Pancras Underground Station and then get off at Holloway Road. Walk for about 5 minutes till you reach the Emirates Stadium. By Train The three closest train stations to the Emirates Stadium are Drayton Park, Finsbury Park or Highbury, and Islington.
highlights: Discover interesting stories about the home ground of Arsenal F.C. as you take an audio-guided tour around the stadium.
Explore the stadium firsthand and get a feel of how your favourite players feel while playing the beautiful game here.
With an audioguide available in 9 languages, get a fascinating insight into the rich history of Arsenal football club.
Enjoy a visit to the Arsenal Museum and relive some of the most celebrated moments in Arsenal's history.
Did you know? Arsenal earned its name from a group of cannon makers at Woolwich Arsenal in 1886, hence the nickname 'The Gunners'.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Art in Paradise Chiang Mai is the first fully interactive 3D illusion art museum in Northern Thailand. globaltix_product_data.description: Art in Paradise Chiang Mai is the first fully interactive 3D illusion art museum in Northern Thailand. Unlike a traditional gallery where art is only meant to be viewed from a distance, this 3-story indoor museum encourages visitors to step directly into the paintings, creating mind-bending optical illusions that come alive in photographs. The entire venue features over 130 large-scale, hyper-realistic murals designed by professional Korean illusion artists. Exhibition Zones The museum is divided into 8 distinct themed galleries that you can explore at your own pace: Aqua & Zoo Zones: Walk on the ocean floor alongside sharks, or stand right next to exotic wild animals. Dinosaur Zone: Escape from prehistoric predators bursting through the walls. Classic Art & Surrealism: Step inside famous masterpieces by historical painters, twisted with fun and quirky optical illusions. Egyptian, Thai, & Lanna Zones: Explore a Pharaoh's tomb, fly on a magic carpet, or immerse yourself in local Northern Thai heritage and cultural scenes. The AR Magic App A major feature of the museum is its custom Augmented Reality (AR) mobile app. When you point your phone’s camera at designated paintings through the app, the artwork animates on your screen—volcanoes erupt, dinosaurs roar, and water flows around you—allowing you to record interactive video clips alongside standard photos. Logistics & Visitor Info Location: Located on Charoen Mueang Road in the Tha Sala district (very close to the Chiang Mai Night Bazaar area). Operating Hours: Open daily from 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM (Last entry is typically at 6:00 PM). Duration: Expect to spend about 1 to 2 hours to fully walk through and pose at the different photo markers. Facilities: The facility is fully enclosed and air-conditioned, making it a great indoor option for mid-day heat or rainy days. It also features an on-site cafe and restaurant.
highlights: Interactive 3D Art: Over 130 illusion paintings that allow you to step inside and become part of the artwork.
Indoor Air-Conditioned Comfort: A fully enclosed, cool environment that provides a great escape from hot or rainy days.
AR Magic App: A dedicated augmented reality app that brings the paintings to life with animation and sound effects.
8 Themed Zones: Features diverse galleries including Underwater World, Wildlife, Classic Art, Ancient Egypt, and Surrealism

globaltix_product_data.description: You can't visit Barcelona and not heighten your appreciation of the beautiful. Grab this skip the line ticket and get speedy access to six of the best art museums in the Catalan capital for the price of three. The Museu Picasso of Barcelona, Museu Nacional d’Art de Catalunya (MNAC),Fundació Joan Miró, The Centre de Cultura Contemporània de Barcelona (CCCB), Museu d’Art Contemporani de Barcelona (MACBA), and the Fundació Antoni Tàpies. After purchase this ticket is valid for a total of 12 months.The Museu Picasso of Barcelona, opened on the 9th of March 1963, is the reference center for Pablo Picasso’s formative years. With more than 4,000 works in the permanent collection, here's one of the best places in the world to get up close to Pablo's genius.The Museu Nacional d’Art de Catalunya (MNAC) has a unique collection of Romanesque murals, Gothic and Renasissance art, as well as a considerable collection of art and design objects. Don't miss the Modernisme section, nor the rooftop, where you get 360º views of Barcelona.“I’m pleased to have created an open space, a place where people can stroll around and learn”. Years after Miró spoke these words the Fundació Joan Miró has become an internationally renowned museum. Here visi­tors can learn more about Miró and get exposed to works by up and coming artists (as was Miró's vision for his foundation).The Centre de Cultura Contemporània de Barcelona (CCCB) is a space for exhibitions and activities focused on the city and contemporary culture. A hotbed of experimentation, it's open to cinema, mu­sic, the performing arts and any other discipline you can invent.The Museu d’Art Contemporani de Barcelona (MACBA) offers an enticing exhibition programme of outstanding contempo­rary art. Its iconic main building, designed by Richard Meier, features captivating exhibitions for art lovers and a permanent collection of more than 5,800 works. The Fundació Antoni Tàpies, created by the painter Antoni Tàpies, has as its goal the promotion of knowledge of modern and contemporary art. The Fundació houses one of the most complete public collections of Tàpies’ work, and organizes activities and temporary exhibitions on con­temporary art.

Discover Barcelona's six best art museums for the price of three! If a pub crawl isn't your thing, a museum crawl may be just what you need
