globaltix_product_data.description: More than 700 different species of animals call the ARTIS Zoo home. Well, none of them can actually talk, but they live here. And on your visit you'll get the chance to visit the penguins, wolves, giraffes and more. There's also an impressive art collection, a zoological library, a planetarium and 26 more historical buildings. It's a history-filled menagerie, in a quiet and quaint canal district - there's a little something for everyone at ARTIS.Elephants, penguins, giraffes, alligators and more are onsite here at Europe's oldest zoo. Walk through the leafy environment, among the beautiful buildings and soak up the atmosphere and animal sightings. Built in 1838, ARTIS has 27 monumental, historic buildings as part of its campus. (This historic significance is sadly lost on most of the residents).The whole experience is wonderfully wild, yet refined. There's art in its aquarium (alongside the sea creatures), an old-timey zoological library just behind the anteaters, and an excellent restaurant with a terrace overlooking the aviary. Yet another crowd pleaser is the Butterfly Garden – the only place you're likely to find a real life fluttering hairpiece, if one of the hundreds of butterflies lands on your head.
highlights: Spot 27 different monuments including several historical buildings, and get starry-eyed in the planetarium, which has different shows each day

globaltix_product_data.description: Escape the hustle and bustle of downtown and immerse yourself in nature with this exhilarating package. Begin your ATV adventure by receiving thorough safety instructions from your experienced guide. Then, embark on an exciting journey through the countryside, where you'll encounter Lubuk Semilang Waterfall and lush tropical vegetation along winding trails. Take a break to interact with locals in a Malaysian mountain village, before continuing to explore scenic surroundings at your leisure. Traverse off-road terrain to visit a vegetable farm and rubber plantation, all while enjoying convenient transfers between your hotel in Kua and the starting point of your adventure.
highlights: Interact with welcoming locals and gain insight into their daily lives as you explore a traditional village.
Uncover fresh ways to discover Langkawi through an exhilarating ATV adventure just beyond Kuah.
Traverse the island's countryside on a contemporary ATV, journeying to Lubuk Semilang and an man-made waterfall.
Navigate through numerous streams, rice fields, and other terrain alongside your knowledgeable ATV guide

globaltix_product_data.description: Experience the magic of Auckland's Waitematā Harbour with a 2.5-hour sailing and dining adventure. Departing from Viaduct Harbour, this cruise offers a unique opportunity to savor a delectable three-course meal while taking in the city's iconic landmarks and skyline from the water. Whether you're seeking a romantic evening or a memorable outing with friends and family, this dinner cruise provides an unforgettable blend of culinary delight and scenic beauty.
highlights: Scenic Views: Witness the breathtaking Auckland skyline, sail under the Harbour Bridge, and capture stunning sunset vistas.
Three-Course Gourmet Dinner: Indulge in a delicious meal catered by the renowned Viaduct restaurant, The Lula Inn.
Knowledgeable Crew: Learn about Auckland's rich maritime history and landmarks from the friendly and informative crew.
2.5-Hour Sailing Experience: Cruise the tranquil waters of Waitematā Harbour aboard a comfortable sailing vessel.
Welcome Drink: Enjoy a complimentary beverage upon boarding to start your evening.
inclusions: 3-course set menu (Please specify your choice of main meal and dessert at the time of booking).
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Guests are required to check in 15 minutes before the scheduled departure time. Children must be 5 years or older to participate in this cruise. Please dress according to the weather conditions and wear flat-soled shoes for safety and comfort. globaltix_product_data.description: The TV anime Attack on Titan x Nijigen no Mori Collaboration Event is an immersive outdoor attraction located within Nijigen no Mori on Awaji Island, Japan. This limited-time themed experience brings the world of Attack on Titan to life through large-scale installations, interactive missions, and storytelling environments inspired by the anime’s iconic scenes and characters. Guests will step into a recreated battlefield setting, complete with life-sized Titans, fortress walls, and dramatic visual effects. The attraction features both day and night programs, including missions where visitors can join the Survey Corps, investigate Titan activity, and experience the story from a first-person perspective. The combination of physical sets, digital elements, and narrative gameplay creates a highly immersive anime experience. The experience typically lasts around 1.5–2.5 hours depending on the selected program and is based on timed entry. Guests check in at the attraction area, receive instructions for their mission, and proceed through designated routes and zones. The experience is partially self-guided but follows a structured flow, allowing participants to fully engage with the storyline and activities.

Step into the world of Attack on Titan with immersive missions, life-sized Titans, and interactive storytelling zones.
Experience both daytime missions and dramatic nighttime events with special effects and cinematic atmosphere.
Ideal for anime fans, adventure seekers, and travelers looking for a unique themed outdoor experience.
Includes entry to themed zones, mission-based activities, interactive exhibits, and photo opportunities.

globaltix_product_data.name: Grand Palace, Wat Pho, and Wat Arun Guided Tour
globaltix_product_data.summary: Explore Bangkok’s most iconic cultural and historical landmarks on a guided tour to the Grand Palace, Wat Pho, and Wat Arun. This immersive experience introduces visitors to the rich heritage of Thailand, combining royal history, Buddhist traditions, and stunning temple architecture in one memorable...
globaltix_product_data.description: Explore Bangkok’s most iconic cultural and historical landmarks on a guided tour to the Grand Palace, Wat Pho, and Wat Arun. This immersive experience introduces visitors to the rich heritage of Thailand, combining royal history, Buddhist traditions, and stunning temple architecture in one memorable journey. Your tour begins at the Grand Palace, a magnificent complex that served as the official residence of Thai kings since 1782 and remains one of the country’s most important royal and religious sites. The palace complex includes ornate halls, golden spires, and the revered Temple of the Emerald Buddha. Next, visit Wat Pho, one of Bangkok’s oldest temples and home to the famous Reclining Buddha, a massive 46-meter-long statue symbolizing the Buddha’s entry into Nirvana. The temple is also known as the birthplace of traditional Thai massage. Finally, cross the Chao Phraya River to visit Wat Arun, also known as the Temple of Dawn, famous for its striking central tower decorated with colorful porcelain tiles and offering beautiful views of the river and old Bangkok. This guided tour is ideal for travelers who want to experience Bangkok’s most famous temples while learning about Thai culture, religion, and history from a knowledgeable guide.

Admire the giant Reclining Buddha at Wat Pho
Discover the stunning riverside temple Wat Arun (Temple of Dawn)

Visit three of Bangkok’s most famous landmarks in one tour

Attraction Access Enjoy a guided tour of three of Bangkok’s most iconic landmarks: the Grand Palace, Wat Pho, and Wat Arun. Explore the Grand Palace complex, the former royal residence of the Kings of Thailand. Visit Wat Phra Kaew (Temple of the Emerald Buddha) located within the Grand Palace grounds. Discover Wat Pho, home to the famous Reclining Buddha statue and one of Thailand’s oldest temples. Cross the Chao Phraya River to visit Wat Arun (Temple of Dawn), known for its distinctive riverside architecture. The guided tour typically lasts around 3–4 hours, depending on the selected option and group pace. Additional Information The tour includes a licensed English-speaking guide and entrance fees to the temples. Transportation between locations may include local boat rides across the Chao Phraya River. The tour involves moderate walking, as the temple complexes are large and require exploring on foot. Small group tours may be available depending on the option selected. Important Notes A strict dress code applies when visiting temples and the Grand Palace. Shoulders and knees must be covered; sleeveless tops, short skirts, and shorts above the knee are not permitted. Comfortable walking shoes are recommended due to uneven surfaces and extensive walking. Large bags and luggage are not allowed inside certain temple areas. globaltix_product_data.summary: Bangkok Elephant Park is a purpose-built, ethical elephant rescue and rehabilitation sanctuary located on a fertile, rural plot in Bangkok’s eastern Nong Chok district. Established out of a mission to end elephant exploitation in forced labor and riding camps, it serves as a peaceful retirement home...
globaltix_product_data.description: Bangkok Elephant Park is a purpose-built, ethical elephant rescue and rehabilitation sanctuary located on a fertile, rural plot in Bangkok’s eastern Nong Chok district. Established out of a mission to end elephant exploitation in forced labor and riding camps, it serves as a peaceful retirement home where rescued elephants can live naturally while educating visitors on wildlife conservation. The park is designed around a strict no-riding and no-performance policy. Instead, visitors take part in a hands-on care routine within a picturesque landscape of jungles, open grazing fields, and natural mud ponds. What to Expect (Typical Program Flow) Educational Briefing: Upon arrival, guides explain the individual rescue stories of the resident elephants, the differences between Asian and African species, and safety rules for respectful interaction. Cultural Souvenir Workshop: Visitors participate in a unique cultural break to craft a traditional, handmade Thai herbal inhaler (Ya Dom) to keep as a souvenir. Feeding & Care Routine: You get up close to hand-feed the elephants fresh fruits like bananas, pineapples, and cucumbers. Afterward, you help mash nutritious ingredients to roll into specialized elephant vitamin balls. Jungle Walk & Observation: Guests walk alongside the elephants at a respectful distance as they roam freely into the jungle, graze on native plants, and socialize. Mud Spa & River Bathing: A major highlight where you enter the natural pools to apply protective mud to their skin and then help brush and scrub them clean in the water. Amenities & Dining: Programs conclude with time to shower and change (towels and uniforms are provided), followed by an authentic traditional Thai buffet lunch box. Practical Information Duration: Offers half-day morning (approx. 7:00 AM – 1:00 PM) and afternoon (approx. 11:00 AM – 5:00 PM) programs, as well as full-day packages. Transportation: Located roughly 1 to 1.5 hours from downtown Bangkok. Booking options are available with or without round-trip hotel transfers. Photography: Sanctuary photographers take professional photos of your interactions throughout the day and upload them online for free download.
highlights: Educational Briefing: Insightful background sessions covering elephant conservation and the individual rescue stories of each resident.
Ethical Interaction: A strict no-riding sanctuary focused purely on feeding, observing, and caring for rescued elephants.
Mud Spa & Bathing: A hands-on activity where you apply protective mud to the elephants and help scrub them clean in the river.
Traditional Workshop: A unique cultural break where you can craft your own traditional Thai herbal inhaler to take home.
Bangkok Location: Situated in rural Nong Chok district, providing a true jungle experience without needing to leave city limits.
globaltix_product_data.address: 47, Krathum Rai, Nong Chok, Bangkok 10530, Thailand

Inspired by the globally popular Jurassic World film franchise, from Universal Pictures and Amblin Entertainment, blending real-world science and education with the very best in high-quality entertainment. Jurassic World: The Experience uses a variety of animatronic technology that when combined with great storytelling, creates an immersive environment where visitors are transported into Jurassic World. Dinosaurs live again and they live in Jurassic World. This groundbreaking, family-friendly adventure of epic proportions is set to open at Asiatique The Riverfront Destination on 8 August, 2025. How to Get to Asiatique The Riverfront Asiatique The Riverfront is conveniently located on Charoenkrung Road along the Chao Phraya River. SKYFLYERS — TICKET TERMS & CONDITIONS

(Operated by Asset World Attraction and Retail Company Limited – “AARC”)

 

1. ACCESSIBILITY

 

  • Skyflyers is a high-altitude and high-speed attraction that carries inherent risks due to sudden movements, rapid elevation changes, wind-induced rotation, and other unpredictable hazards. The ride may reach heights of over 100 meters, with strong wind effects, and may cause intense physical sensations such as elevated heart rate, body pressure, or vertigo. Serious injuries may occur and could result in injury or death, including but not limited to dizziness, vertigo, motion sickness, fainting, muscle strain, cuts and bruises, falls, fractures, sprains, whiplash, abrasions, concussion, heart attack, heat exhaustion, or permanent disability. Therefore, this ride may not be suitable for all guests.

2. RIDER QUALIFICATIONS

 

  • 2.1 Minimum height 120 cm.
  • 2.2 Riders under 140 cm must be accompanied by a responsible paying adult.
  • 2.3 Riders with Heart or cardiovascular issues, neck, back, or spinal problems, high blood pressure, asthma or respiratory concerns, motion sickness, vertigo, panic disorder, pregnancy, or recent surgery, injury, or mobility limitation preventing proper restraint use are not permitted.
  • 2.4 Riders under the influence of alcohol or drugs are not allowed.
  • 2.5 Riders who cannot be properly secured by the safety lock will not be allowed to ride.

 

3. RIDER SAFETY INSTRUCTIONS

 

  • 3.1 No mobile phones, cameras, hats, glasses or pets allowed on the ride.
  • 3.2 Loose items must be stored in lockers or with a non-rider.
  • 3.3 Empty all pockets before boarding.
  • 3.4 Follow staff instructions at all times.
  • 3.5 Failure to comply with the ride rules and regulations including staff instructions will result in denied entry or removal without refund.

 

4. GENERAL PARK RULES

 

  • 4.1 No running, jumping, climbing, or rough behavior
  • 4.2 Shirts and shoes must be worn at all times
  • 4.3 No smoking, vaping, or open flames
  • 4.4 No scooters, skateboards, or bicycles inside
  • 4.5 AARC reserves the right to refuse admission to anyone posing a safety risk.

 

5. TICKETS & CANCELLATION

 

  • 5.1 Each ticket is valid for one (1) SkyFlyers ride on the specified date and time only.
  • 5.2 Advance timeslot booking required
  • 5.3 Operating Hours:
  • Monday – Sunday: 13:00 – 22:00
  • Remarks: Operating hours are subject to change without prior notice.
  • 5.4 Lost or damaged tickets will not be replaced or refunded.
  • 5.5 Tickets are non-refundable and not freely transferable. If a ticket needs to be transferred, the rider must contact the admission crew to complete and sign the waiver form before riding. Failure to comply will result in denied access to the ride, and the rider will be solely responsible for any consequences or damage that may occur.
  • 5.6 In case of suspension (e.g., weather or technical issues), reschedule or refund is at AARC’s sole discretion.

 

6. SAFE PLACE POLICY 

 

  • SkyFlyers is committed to providing a welcoming, respectful, and inclusive environment for all guests.
  • Any guest experiencing harassment, discrimination, or distress may notify staff for immediate assistance.

 

7. WAIVER, RELEASE & ASSUMPTION OF RISK 

By purchasing a ticket and boarding the ride, guests agree to the following:

 

  • 7.1 Participation involves inherent physical risks, including dizziness, motion sickness, or injury.
  • 7.2 Guests assume all risks and dangers related to the ride.
  • 7.3 AARC, its affiliates, owners, officers, directors, employees, and contractors shall not be liable for any injury, damage, or loss.
  • 7.4 Guests waive the right to sue or make any claim against AARC or its affiliates, owners, officers, directors, employees, and contractors
  • 7.5 Personal belongings are the sole responsibility of guests.
  • 7.6 Any injury or accident must be reported to staff before leaving the premises.

 

8. DISPUTE RESOLUTION 

All disputes shall be resolved under the Thai Arbitration Institute (TAI) rules unless otherwise required by law.

 

9. MODIFICATION OF TERMS

AARC reserves the right to amend or update these terms and conditions without prior notice. AARC

The latest version published at the time of purchase or ride participation shall apply.

globaltix_product_data.description: At the agreed time, you will join your guide at the meeting point to begin the guided tour of Barcelona Cathedral, one of the city's most iconic Gothic monuments. From the very start, the guide will take you on a journey through time with clear and engaging explanations, helping you to understand the history of this impressive monument and enjoy the experience from the beginning. During the visit to the cathedral’s impressive interior, you will admire its majestic Gothic vaults, the richly decorated side chapels, and the spectacular stained-glass windows that fill the space with light and color. You will discover unique architectural details, works of art, and key symbols that explain the historical and spiritual evolution of the building over the centuries. The tour continues in the cloister, a place full of calm and meaning, where you will learn about its role in the religious life of the city and the curious tradition of the thirteen geese living there, a symbol of Saint Eulalia. Throughout the tour, the guide will share anecdotes and interesting facts that will make the visit even more interesting, turning it into a complete cultural experience.

globaltix_product_data.description: At the Bali Zoo Park, you're encouraged to get "Zoological" with wildlife - to see animals in their own habitat and to get to know them personally.Home to more than 350 animals, the zoo is situated in the very heart of Bali and offers an amazing educational experience into Bali's stunning nature. Choose between a regular visit, a day time "explorer" tour with animal feeding, transfers and lunch, or find out what the animals are up to after sundown with a night time Bali zoo tour including dinner and transfers. With lots to see, do and discover, Bali Zoo Tour is a great activity for the whole family. Not only will you get to see the Bengal tiger, African lion, and bears up close, but you and the little ones will also get to pet deer, play with rabbits, get hands-on with snakes and baby crocodiles. Combine that with exotic bird shows, pony rides, and playing with elephants and there's something for everyone in the family.

globaltix_product_data.description: Dive headfirst into a realm of opulence, sophistication, and fascinating history on an energizing group tour of the majestic Belvedere Palace. This memory-making expedition offers breezy, skip-the-line entry to the Upper Belvedere, alongside the wisdom of an expert guide teeming with riveting stories. globaltix_product_data.summary: Get fast-track access and guaranteed reservation in a revolving restaurant 200m above the city; this ticket is undoubtedly the best way to see the iconic TV Tower. It also gets you a reservation for the inner circle at the restaurant. Enjoy a delicious meal as you and your table slowly turn, turn, t...
globaltix_product_data.description: Get fast-track access and guaranteed reservation in a revolving restaurant 200m above the city; this ticket is undoubtedly the best way to see the iconic TV Tower. It also gets you a reservation for the inner circle at the restaurant. Enjoy a delicious meal as you and your table slowly turn, turn, turn - giving you an ever-changing panorama of the city. After your meal, continue your visit on the observation deck - and at , Berlin's highest bar.Finished in 1969 by the German Democratic Republic, this iconic tower - which has great nicknames (tele-asparagus) and (toothpick) - is beloved of locals and a must-see for tourists.And, anything worth doing is worth doing right. This ticket gets you timed fast-track access to the (TV Tower). You show up at your reserved timeslot and thus bypass the often lengthy lines that snake around the building all day long. You can walk right up to the doors and stroll inside like a rock star (of course, there is a small wait for the obligatory security checks).But that feeling of 'doing Berlin right' doesn't stop at the entrance; this ticket also includes a reservation at the inner circle of the revolving restaurant (window seat not guaranteed). Here you dine 207m above the city and 4m above the Tower’s observation deck. Breakfast, lunch, or dinner, the menu features local Berlin and Brandenburg cuisine as well as international and seasonal specialties.It takes one hour to revolve a full 360° and all the while, you're soaking up the panoramic views as you dine. Afterward, head down to observation deck and round out your tower experience.Then, with a stomach full of delicious food, and eyes full of delicious views, you'll make your descent, ready for your next Berlin activity.

options.termsAndConditions:
Jurassic World: The Experience

Ticket Terms and Conditions for Jurassic World: The Experience

By purchasing this ticket and/or attending the Jurassic World: The Experience (""Experience""), you agree to the following terms and conditions:

 

1. Tickets

1.1 Access is valid based on your ticket type:

 

  • 1.1.1 Off Peak – Off Peak ticket holder is permitted to gain admission only during designated Off Peak days. Please refer to the official schedule (“Official Schedule”) as defined by ASSET WORLD ATTRACTION AND RETAIL CO.,LTD. and NEON Group of companies (the ""Experience Promoter"").
  • 1.1.2 Peak – Peak ticket holder has the flexibility to gain admission during designated anytime of Peak and Off Peak (After 4pm) days. Please refer to the Official Schedule

1.2. Tickets allow for ONE single entry only as the experience is a one-way journey, and guests will not be allowed to re-enter the Experience.

1.3 You are required to book a timeslot in advance so that you can enter the Experience venue at your preferred timing. Otherwise, you might be asked to return for a later timing if the Experience is operating at maximum capacity.

1.4 Ticket is valid for (Age is calculated according to date of birth):

 

  • 1.4.1 Adult: aged from 11 years and above.
  • 1.4.2 Child: aged between 3 - 10 years. Children age below eighteen (18) years old must be accompanied by at least one adult age over 18 years old. The accompanying adult/ guardian acknowledges and agrees to these ticket and admission terms and conditions.
  • 1.4.3 Child under three (3) years old is free of charge.

1.5. The operating hours of the Experience may change without prior notice. Guests are encouraged to visit the Jurassic World: The Experience – Bangkok website for updates before planning their visit.

1.6 Lost Tickets or damage ticket(s) will not be replaced or refunded.

 

General

 

1.7 Tickets shall not be used for giveaway or promotional purposes, unless approved in writing by the Experience Promoter.

1.8 Please be careful of your safety and belongings at all times. To the extent permitted by law, the Experience Promoter, its partners, vendors, officers and employees, shall not be liable for any damage, injury, illness, loss, cost and/or expense that you may suffer or incur as a result of your attendance at the Experience and/or utilization of the ticket or voucher.

1.9 The Experience venue and premises are under CCTV surveillance for safety and security.

1.10 You consent to the filming or recording and use of your image, photograph, video and/or other recording by the Experience Promoter or its appointed vendor for marketing and promotional purposes.

1.11 The Experience Promoter reserves the right to remove guests with unruly or disruptive behavior, from the Experience venue.

1.12 Any personal data collected by the Experience Promoter, its partners or vendors at the Experience shall be in accordance with the Experience Promoter's Privacy Policy (available on the Jurassic World: The Experience – Bangkok website)

1.13 Strictly no outside food or beverages are permitted on the Experience venue.

1.14 Prohibited Items The following items are not allowed within the exhibit:

 

  • Items that may pose a risk to visitors or dinosaurs such as long sticks, knives, selfie sticks, tripods, etc.
  • Smoking or vaping
  • Pets
  • Food or beverages (except for water for children)

1.15 Health Warning - This experience includes flashing lights, fog, loud noises, and realistic moving robotic dinosaurs, which may not be suitable for individuals with health conditions such as epilepsy or heart problems. Please use discretion when attending.

1.16 Guests under the influence of alcohol, drugs, or any intoxicants are not permitted to enter the venue.

1.17 Do not touch any dinosaurs unless instructed by staff. The dinosaurs in the exhibit are mechanical devices that may pose a risk. Guests will have a special opportunity to touch and interact with the baby dinosaurs under staff supervision.

1.18 All staff will communicate in English or Thai only

1.19 The Experience Promoter reserves the right to amend or add to these Terms & Conditions at any time without prior notice. Please refer to Jurassic World: The Experience – Bangkok website for updates.

1.20 Age shall be calculated on the visit date, each guest shall show his/her identification card for Thai people or show his/her passport for foreigners.

 

Better World Better Future

By purchasing the ticket and attending Better World Better Future, guests agree to the following terms and conditions:

 

 

  • Operating Hours: from 11:00 AM to 09:00 PM, and subject to change depending on the discretion of Asset World Attraction and Retail Company Limited (“AARC”).
  • Validity: Tickets are valid for a single admission on the specified date and time only. 
  • Cancellation Policy: Tickets are non-refundable. 

 

1. Tickets are valid for a single admission only.

2. Guests must book a timeslot in advance and may participate only on the specific date and time indicated on the ticket.

3. Children under 3 years old are not allowed to participate in this activity. Children aged 3 years and above will be charged the same rate as adults.

4. Guests with certain medical conditions, including those with heart or cardiovascular issues, neck, back, or spinal problems, high blood pressure, asthma or respiratory concerns, motion sickness, vertigo, panic disorder, pregnancy, or recent surgery, injury, or mobility limitation preventing proper restraint use are not permitted.

5. For safety reasons, who cannot be properly secured by the safety belt will not be allowed to participate in the 4D room.

6. Lost or damaged tickets will not be replaced or refunded.

7. Terms and conditions as well as operating hours are subject to change without prior notice.

8. In the event of any dispute, the decision of Asset World Attraction and Retail Company Limited (“AARC”) shall be final.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Bode Museum combines Byzantine Art with one of the largest collections of sculptures in the world. And, as a bonus, it's one of the most stunning buildings in Berlin! Situated on the north side of Museum Island, visitors can admire the stunning handiwork of some of the finest craftsmen and artists o...
globaltix_product_data.description: Bode Museum combines Byzantine Art with one of the largest collections of sculptures in the world. And, as a bonus, it's one of the most stunning buildings in Berlin! Situated on the north side of Museum Island, visitors can admire the stunning handiwork of some of the finest craftsmen and artists of the age. Skip the line and get right into wonderful artworks from the past.A visit to the Bode will expose you to waves of art from around the world. The museum's collections draw from several historical eras - from the end of the Roman Empire right up until the 19th century. Art movements covered include the Christian Orient, Byzantium, Ravenna, Italian Gothic, Renaissance, and Baroque eras, among others. Soak up masterpieces from a broad range of times and locations.And if that wasn’t enough, the Bode Museum also houses the (Coin Cabinet) with an incredible 500,000 items - including pieces from Ancient Greece, Rome, the Middle East, and the Orient. The Bode Museum was built at the turn of the 20th century for Crown Princess Victoria of Prussia. She wanted to display paintings and sculptures side-by-side. Art historian and curator Wilhelm von Bode fulfilled Her Highness's wishes, and changed the way art is displayed ever after. And Von Bode got this fantastic museum named in his honor.

At the House of Bols you will find out everything a...
globaltix_product_data.description: A visit to The House of Bols, The Cocktail & Genever Experience on Museum Square in Amsterdam, is a unique adventure and an unforgettable interactive experience of the glamorous world of cocktails, liqueurs, bartending and the Dutch spirit Genever. At the House of Bols you will find out everything about Lucas Bols – the world’s oldest distilled spirit brand, which has been making liqueurs in Amsterdam since 1575! You will also discover Bols Genever – Holland’s rediscovered cocktail spirit.House of Bols takes you on a spectacular journey through flavours, aromas, images, sound and film. The tour incorporates the Hall of Taste, where you will discover all 38 Bols liqueurs and how they are made, the Delfts blue room, the World of Cocktails ‘club’ and the mysterious Bols Genever Room.The tour ends at the revolutionary Mirror Bar, where bartenders mix your preferred Bols Genever and craft a beautiful cocktail before your very eyes. Or maybe test your mixology skills by preparing your own drink! Those who wish to learn the art of flair bartending (think Tom Cruise in ‘Cocktail’) can do so in the magical Flair Booth with the specially designed Bols flair bottles. Cocktail enthusiasts can also shop till they drop in the Bols Shop or enjoy a second Bols cocktail for just € 6,50.As winner of the Dutch Design Award for Best Exhibition and Experience, House of Bols is proving that heritage and history mix perfectly with innovation and contemporary design.House of Bols is located in the famous Museum Quarter of Amsterdam, right across from the Van Gogh Museum and next to the Rijksmuseum.

globaltix_product_data.name: Bonorong Wildlife Sanctuary Tickets
globaltix_product_data.summary: Pay a visit to Tasmania's ever-popular Bonorong Wildlife Sanctuary during the day with a general admission ticket and get up close to all of the animal favourites that call the sanctuary home. From koalas and kangaroos to Tasmanian devils, Bonorong Wildlife Sanctuary is a haven for recovering and or...
globaltix_product_data.description: Pay a visit to Tasmania's ever-popular Bonorong Wildlife Sanctuary during the day with a general admission ticket and get up close to all of the animal favourites that call the sanctuary home. From koalas and kangaroos to Tasmanian devils, Bonorong Wildlife Sanctuary is a haven for recovering and orphaned animals of all shapes and sizes in the region. This great sanctuary is always a hit with the kids as they'll be able to have a face-to-face, fun and educational encounter with native Aussie wildlife. The famously friendly keepers aim to both inform and entertain guests. With a large mobs of free-ranging kangaroos, as well as a number of species that are now extinct in all other parts of Australian except Tasmania, Bonorong Wildlife Sanctuary provides one of the most personal, intimate and enjoyable animal-oriented days out in the state. In addition to exploring the sanctuary on your own, you can also take part in one of the daily guided tours. There are four daily tours to choose from; 10:00am, 11:30am, 1:30pm and 3:30pm, with each running for 45-minutes and providing a great amount of fun and information for everyone to enjoy. It's easily reachable from Hobart and ideal for a day trip, so grab your tickets online here today! Inclusions * General Admission * Complimentary bag of kangaroo feed * 45 minute wildlife tour (10:00am, 11:30am, 1:30pm and 3:30pm daily) Highlights * Large mob of friendly, free-ranging kangaroos - meet them all by hand-feeding with a complimentary bag of kangaroo feed * Bonorong has a number of species that are sadly now extinct everywhere but Tasmania * The Tasmanian devil, the Eastern quoll and the shy Tasmanian bettong * Make us part of a day trip - within 45 minutes of Bonorong you can find fantastic sites such as the Richmond Bridge, Mt Wellington, the Cadbury Chocolate Factory, Mt Field National Park, the famous Salamanca Market, and many of our internationally recognised wineries and breweries * Full 45-min wildlife tours take place every day at 10:00am, 11:30am, 1:30pm and 3:30pm. You can see the Tassie devil eat a snack, learn about their quirky personalities as well as some of the threats they face and the efforts to help protect them. They also include the opportunity to meet the wombat and koala and give them a pat Time * Open every day of the year including weekends and public holidays (except Christmas Day) * 25 minutes from Hobart's CBD and just off the A1 directly from Launceston Location __Via car from Hobart__ * Take the A1 (the main highway between Hobart and Launceston) north out of the Hobart city centre. * When you reach Granton, take the second exit (turning right) at the roundabout and cross over Bridgewater Bridge. * Continue straight through the roundabout immediately after the bridge (past the fast food restaurant on the left). * At the next roundabout, take the first exit to turn on to the Brighton Bypass. * Drive for 3-5 minutes, keeping an eye out for the large sign on the left hand sign reading "Bonorong Wildlife Centre". Take the first exit after you see this sign, staying in the left lane. * At the T intersection, turn left, following the Bonorong sign. Note: this is now a 60km an hour zone. * Follow this road around the bend - you will soon see Briggs Road on your left, with a small sign for 'Bonorong Wildlife Park'. Turn left onto Briggs Road. * Bonorong is approximately 1 kilometre up this road on the left hand side (past the train tracks). Take the driveway up to the main carpark. You've arrived! __Via car from Launceston__ * Follow the A1 (the main highway between Launceston and Hobart), south towards Hobart. The journey from Launceston to Bonorong will take about 2 hours. * After approximately 170km, you will pass through the town of Mangalore, then come to a large roundabout. * Take the first exit at the roundabout to stay on the A1 highway. * As you continue along the highway you will see large information signs indicating an exit to Tea Tree Rd/C321 (and also signs for Bonorong). * Take this exit off the highway. * At the intersection, turn right and continue along for approximately 1km until you see a small Bonorong sign directing you to turn left on to Briggs Rd. * Continue along Briggs Rd, passing over the train tracks, until you see Bonorong Wildlife Sanctuary on the left hand side. * Turn into the driveway and up to the main carpark. You've arrived! Additional Information * EFTPOS facilities are available * Family passes are available direct with Bonorong Wildlife Sanctuary and are not currently offered by Experience Oz Booking Information * Confirmation in the form of a tour voucher will be received at time of booking * Upon completion of purchase, please print the voucher and present on day of the experience * Mobile vouchers are accepted! - vouchers can also be presented on your mobile device * For your information, complete Tour Operator Information including contact details is included on your tour voucher

globaltix_product_data.description: Borobudur Temple is an architectural masterpiece built by the Syailendra Dynasty on a hilltop. The view from the top of Borobudur Temple is one of the best you can experience in Indonesia. From the open areas within the Borobudur Temple Tourism Park, you can see the upper levels of this magnificent structure. The stunning view of Borobudur Temple will truly add value to any event held at the Borobudur Temple Tourism Park.
highlights: UNESCO Wonder: Explore Borobudur Temple, the world’s largest Buddhist monument with 9 stacked platforms and over 2,600 intricate relief panels.
Sunrise Experience: Witness golden sunrise views over misty jungles and volcano backdrops—an iconic and peaceful start to your visit.
Storytelling Reliefs: Discover ancient carvings that narrate Buddhist teachings, offering an immersive cultural and historical journey.
Interactive Exploration: Walk through ascending levels symbolizing enlightenment, with each tier revealing new perspectives and photo spots.
Scenic Surroundings: Enjoy panoramic views of lush landscapes and nearby mountains, enhancing the temple’s serene and spiritual atmosphere.
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Admission The ticket is only valid on the selected visit date. Eligibility Adults: 11 years old and above. Children: 3–10 years old. Infants: no ticket required for children aged 1–2 years old. Attraction Access Visitors are allowed to visit Zone 1 up to the temple’s courtyard. Visitors are not allowed to enter or climb up the temple structure. Re-entry is not allowed after leaving the venue. Additional Information Visitor arrival and parking area are centralized at Borobudur Kujon Art Village. How to Get There Borobudur Temple is accessible by car or bus from Yogyakarta (approximately a 1.5-hour drive). Organized tours are also available from major cities in Java.

options.name: [Non-Indonesian] Borobudur Temple Structure Ticket
options.description: Visit the iconic Borobudur Temple, an architectural masterpiece built by the Syailendra Dynasty and recognized as one of Indonesia’s most significant cultural landmarks. This ticket grants access to the temple structure, allowing you to explore its intricate design and historical features up close. Ascend through the temple’s levels and admire detailed stone carvings that reflect ancient Buddhist teachings and craftsmanship. From the upper tiers, enjoy panoramic views of the surrounding landscape, offering a memorable cultural and visual experience. This experience provides a deeper appreciation of Borobudur’s heritage, making it ideal for visitors interested in history, architecture, and cultural exploration. How to Get There Borobudur Temple is accessible by car or bus from Yogyakarta (approximately a 1.5-hour drive). Organized tours are also available from major cities in Java.

Stroll through the spacious park, take in scenic views of the temple from designated viewpoints, and appreciate the grandeur of this UNESCO-listed site from the outside. The landscaped surroundings provide a relaxing environment for walking, photography, and enjoying the cultural atmosphere. This ticket is ideal for visitors who wish to experience the beauty and scale of Borobudur from the ground level in a flexible and leisurely way. How to Get There Borobudur Temple is accessible by car or bus from Yogyakarta (approximately a 1.5-hour drive). Organized tours are also available from major cities in Java.
options.termsAndConditions: Admission The ticket is only valid on the selected visit date. Eligibility Adults: 11 years old and above. Children: 3–10 years old. Infants: no ticket required for children aged 1–2 years old. Attraction Access Tickets are only valid for access to the temple courtyard and not for climbing the Borobudur Temple structure. Visitors are allowed to visit Zone 1 up to the temple’s courtyard. Visitors are not allowed to enter or climb up the temple structure. Re-entry is not allowed after leaving the venue.
howToUse: Show Mobile Ticket: Turnstile Gate
inclusions: Admission to Borobudur Temple Yard only

options.name: Golden Horn Departured Standard Menu & Unlimited Soft Drinks
options.description: Make your way to the pier located in front of Kadir Has University, near the Cibali Tram Station. Look for the cruise boat named Mega Lüfer-3, which will be waiting on the waterfront (shoreline) directly across from the university entrance. After getting off at Cibali Tram Station (T5 Line), walk towards the waterfront on your right-hand side. The pier is located along the shoreline — just a 1-minute walk from the station exit. You can use public transportation to reach the meeting point easily: From Eminönü or Alibeyköy: Take the T5 Tram and get off at Cibali Station. From Taksim or Şişli: Take the M2 Metro to Şişhane Station, then walk about 15 minutes across the Atatürk Bridge to reach to the port. From Sultanahmet or Karaköy: Take the T1 Tram to Eminönü, then transfer to T5 Tram and get off at Cibali.

globaltix_product_data.description: Cruise along the Brisbane River to take in sights of the beautiful Brisbane region from on board the MV Neptune where you’ll spend the afternoon learning about the region from an on board commentator. A great afternoon on the water for both locals and tourists, River City Cruises is one of Brisbane’s best and the original sightseeing cruises on the Brisbane River. For the duration of the cruise you’ll be taken past some of Brisbane’s most iconic locations and sights such as the picturesque Kangaroo Point, the towering CBD and the Story Bridge. This guided tour runs for 1.5 hours and in that time you can take advantage of the many photo opportunities and grab a refreshment from the on board coffee shop and licensed bar. Guests will also receive a complimentary souvenir map that includes discount vouchers for various experiences and attractions around the city. The cruise departs 12:30pm daily and returns at 2-m, ensuring the best part of the day is spent in the best way possible; aboard a scenic sightseeing cruise.

Upon entering the iconic tower, visitors are greeted by a lavish lobby, setting the tone for the opulence and grandeur to come. Aboard the high-speed elevators, guests are swiftly transported...
globaltix_product_data.description: Embarking on a tour of the Burj Khalifa promises an unforgettable journey into the heart of Dubai's skyline. Upon entering the iconic tower, visitors are greeted by a lavish lobby, setting the tone for the opulence and grandeur to come. Aboard the high-speed elevators, guests are swiftly transported skyward, treated to mesmerizing glimpses of the cityscape through the elevator's glass panels. Arriving at the observation decks on the 124th and 125th floors, visitors are rewarded with panoramic views that stretch as far as the eye can see. From the glittering Arabian Gulf to the sprawling desert landscapes, every angle offers a new perspective on Dubai's beauty. Informative displays and telescopes enrich the experience, providing insights into the city's landmarks and history. Whether it's your first visit or a return journey, a tour of the Burj Khalifa promises an awe-inspiring adventure that will leave a lasting impression.
highlights: Soaring at 828 meters, Burj Khalifa is the tallest structure on the planet.
Enjoy breathtaking 360° views of Dubai from the observation decks on Level 124, 125, and 148.
Catch the dazzling LED light shows and the world’s largest choreographed fountain at its base.

globaltix_product_data.summary: The K-LIMOUSINE Ride Voucher (One Way) provides a reliable airport transfer service between Incheon International Airport and central Seoul via routes 6701, 6702, 6703, 6705, N6701, and N6703. Passengers must exchange the QR voucher for an official paper ticket at the designated ticket counters in T...
globaltix_product_data.description: The K-LIMOUSINE Ride Voucher (One Way) provides a reliable airport transfer service between Incheon International Airport and central Seoul via routes 6701, 6702, 6703, 6705, N6701, and N6703. Passengers must exchange the QR voucher for an official paper ticket at the designated ticket counters in Terminal 1 or Terminal 2 before boarding. Pick-up points are clearly marked outside the Arrivals Hall at Terminal 1 or at the Bus Transfer Station in Terminal 2. With frequent departures and comfortable coach facilities, this service ensures a safe and efficient connection between the airport and major city destinations.
highlights: One-way K-LIMOUSINE airport bus voucher with multiple Seoul city routes available.
Comfortable coach seating with luggage storage for a smooth journey.
Direct transfer between Incheon Airport and major Seoul districts.
Frequent departures from early morning until late night, including night routes.
Easy QR voucher redemption at official airport ticket counters.
inclusions: one-way ticket [K-Limousine Bus Ticket 6701, 6702, 6703, 6705A, N6701, N6703]
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: This product has a flat rate, and children aged 6 and above must purchase tickets. Children under 6 can ride for free without occupying a seat, but must present valid age verification documents on the day of travel and cannot ride alone—they must be accompanied by an adult. Passengers who purchase an adult ticket will receive a free baggage allowance of 40 kg for checked baggage. The free baggage allowance is limited to two pieces with a total weight limit of 40 kg. Excess baggage fee: KRW 16,000 for 1 piece of baggage, with each piece not exceeding 40 kg.
globaltix_product_data.address: 272 Gonghang-ro, Jung-gu, Incheon, South Korea

SkyBus Melbourne City Express is the smart way to travel to the city in less than 30 minutes. Relax in comfortable modern coaches and take advantage of the FREE Wifi throughout the journey as you adjust to a new city. A complimentary transfer from Southern Cross Station to eight city locations can help you make the connection to your hotel seamless. SkyBus operates in Melbourne 24hrs a day, 7 days a week with departures every 10 minutes from Tullamarine Airport. Travelling to Melbourne City has never been easier or more affordable with a SkyBus airport transfer.
highlights: Clean, comfortable and modern fleet

Free City Transfer connection on SkyBus Link service
One way or return transfer options available
No excess luggage fees and Free on board WiFi

globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Admission Departures operate every 15 minutes. Melbourne Airport: Kerbside at Terminals 1, 3 & 4. Melbourne City: Southern Cross Station Coach Terminal. Average travel time is approximately 30 minutes. During peak hours (6am–10am & 3pm–7pm), travel time may take up to 45 minutes. Eligibility Child Ticket: Ages 4–16 years old. Attraction Access Complimentary city transfer is available via the SkyBus Link service. Please download the SkyBus app for detailed information on stops and timetables. Guests must present a valid voucher (printed or mobile) upon boarding. Additional Information Confirmation in the form of a tour voucher will be received at time of booking Upon completion of purchase, please print the voucher and present on day of travel Complete Tour Operator information and contact details are included on the voucher. Important Notes Please arrive at the designated pick-up point at least 10 minutes before the scheduled departure time. Guests are advised to wait at the designated pick-up area at least 10 minutes prior to departure to avoid missing the service. How to Get There SkyBus operates from designated terminals at Melbourne Airport (Tullamarine). Simply follow the signs for SkyBus upon arrival. In the city, SkyBus arrives and departs from Southern Cross Station, which is easily accessible by tram, train, and bus.

options.name: forest adventures park entry- 2.5 hours
options.description: Experience the Ludlow Tuart Forest from a whole new perspective on an adrenaline-fuelled high ropes adventure course in Western Australia. Set amongst the towering trees, six huge obstacle courses combine rope and wire challenges plus over 500 metres of flying foxes. The aerial adventure spans over eight acres of natural bushland and is a unique activity for all nature lovers and outdoor adventurers. Each session lasts for approximately two hours and during this time you will be able to tackle at least two courses that vary in height and difficulty. Entry fees include all equipment hire and access to the aerial obstacles that will see you swinging through the trees like Tarzan, trying a 13m base jump or riding a BMX on a wire. Bring along a sense of adventure and challenge yourself to two hours of pure fun on this forest adventure. Inclusions * 2.5-hour exhilarating journey through the amazing forest as you take on suspended obstacles, Tarzan swings and breathtaking flying foxes * All equipment hire and access to the courses for the entire duration of your visit * Expect to complete two to three courses during your visit Highlights * In WA’s beautiful South West environment, Forest Adventures combines ultimate fun in an incredible setting * Combining world class European standards for safety and design with the South West’s supreme environment * Six huge courses combine rope and wire challenges to provide two hours of pure fun * More than 500 metres of flying foxes * Unicycle through the trees * Tarzan ropes * 13-metre base jump * BMX on a wire * Spider webs Time * Open Thursday to Monday during WA school term and 7 days a week during school holidays * Session times 9am, 10am, 11am, 12pm, 1pm, 2pm and 3pm Duration * Two hours (approx) * You can expect to complete two to three courses during your visit What To Bring * Dress comfortably in clothing that you would typically wear for outdoor activities (no loose clothing) * Enclosed shoes are essential Additional Information * Participants must be minimum 7 years of age and 110 cm tall * Maximum weight for participants is 120 kg * Child (7 - 8 years) - must be accompanied by a climbing adult * Arrive 20 minutes early to allow for harnessing so you have as much time in the trees as possible! Each session starts with a safety briefing and demonstration * The course starts with a safety training session, and progresses onto the yellow (kids') course, green (kids’ +) course, light blue (family) course, red (advanced) course and finally the black (adrenaline) course * Courses vary in height and difficulty, ranging from 3 metres – 19 metres off the ground. You begin on the yellow course and decide how far and how high you would like to go * No loose clothing or shirts wrapped around the waist * Long pants and long sleeve shirts, although not essential, can reduce the risk of being bitten by insects (the forest is home to insects like flies and mosquitoes) * Long hair must be tied back * Avoid jewellery that could get caught in a rope Cancellation Policy * Our staff reserve the right to refuse any guest entry to the courses if they are unable to complete our practice course on their own, in a safe and timely manner, and without injuring themselves, damaging equipment or endangering others on the course. If a guest attempts and is unable to complete the practice course, a voucher will be issued valid for three years * Any changes/refunds to confirmed bookings must be received by close of business (5pm WST) on the day prior to your booking * Refunds will not be given if participants arrive in inappropriate clothing and footwear – see above for requirements * Refunds will not be given if participants do not meet the age, height and weight restrictions * No same day refunds * No refunds for late arrivals Booking Information * Mobile Vouchers are accepted! - Vouchers can also be presented on your mobile device for this attraction * Confirmation in the form of a tour voucher will be received at time of booking * Upon completion of purchase, please print the voucher and present on day of the experience * Availability was accurate at the time of booking however, is subject to change due to circumstances out of our control * For your information, complete Tour Operator Information including contact details is included on your tour voucher * We strongly suggest reconfirming your booking with the tour operator within 24 hours of making your booking and prior to making other travel arrangements

globaltix_product_data.name: Langkawi Island Hopping Tour
globaltix_product_data.summary: Langkawi is known for its stunning natural landscapes, and the boat tour will provide you with breathtaking views of the islands, each with its unique charm. As you navigate through the waters, be prepared to witness the diverse flora and fauna that inhabit the islands. Langkawi is home to a rich va...
globaltix_product_data.description: Langkawi is known for its stunning natural landscapes, and the boat tour will provide you with breathtaking views of the islands, each with its unique charm. As you navigate through the waters, be prepared to witness the diverse flora and fauna that inhabit the islands. Langkawi is home to a rich variety of tropical plants and wildlife. Depending on the tour, you might also learn about the local culture and traditions associated with the islands. Some tours include stops at cultural landmarks or sites of historical importance.
highlights: Island Exploration – Cruise through Langkawi’s southern islands, including scenic stops at Pulau Dayang Bunting and Pulau Beras Basah.
Lake Experience – Visit the legendary Lake of the Pregnant Maiden and enjoy time for swimming, paddle boating, or relaxing in nature.
Wildlife Encounter – Watch majestic eagles soaring and diving during the exciting eagle feeding stop at Singa Besar Island.
Beach Relaxation – Unwind on the soft white sands of Pulau Beras Basah with clear waters ideal for swimming and photos.
Scenic Speedboat Ride – Enjoy a thrilling island-hopping journey across Langkawi’s turquoise waters with panoramic views of limestone cliffs and lush islands.
inclusions: Life jacket (only for on boat usage)
Round-trip transfers to and from your hotel

globaltix_product_data.description: Langkawi is known for its stunning natural landscapes, and the boat tour will provide you with breathtaking views of the islands, each with its unique charm. As you navigate through the waters, be prepared to witness the diverse flora and fauna that inhabit the islands. Langkawi is home to a rich variety of tropical plants and wildlife. Depending on the tour, you might also learn about the local culture and traditions associated with the islands. Some tours include stops at cultural landmarks or sites of historical importance.
highlights: Island Exploration – Cruise through Langkawi’s southern islands, including scenic stops at Pulau Dayang Bunting and Pulau Beras Basah.
Lake Experience – Visit the legendary Lake of the Pregnant Maiden and enjoy time for swimming, paddle boating, or relaxing in nature.
Wildlife Encounter – Watch majestic eagles soaring and diving during the exciting eagle feeding stop at Singa Besar Island.
Beach Relaxation – Unwind on the soft white sands of Pulau Beras Basah with clear waters ideal for swimming and photos.
Scenic Speedboat Ride – Enjoy a thrilling island-hopping journey across Langkawi’s turquoise waters with panoramic views of limestone cliffs and lush islands.

globaltix_product_data.description: Langkawi is known for its stunning natural landscapes, and the boat tour will provide you with breathtaking views of the islands, each with its unique charm. As you navigate through the waters, be prepared to witness the diverse flora and fauna that inhabit the islands. Langkawi is home to a rich variety of tropical plants and wildlife. Depending on the tour, you might also learn about the local culture and traditions associated with the islands. Some tours include stops at cultural landmarks or sites of historical importance.
highlights: Island Exploration – Cruise through Langkawi’s southern islands, including scenic stops at Pulau Dayang Bunting and Pulau Beras Basah.
Lake Experience – Visit the legendary Lake of the Pregnant Maiden and enjoy time for swimming, paddle boating, or relaxing in nature.
Wildlife Encounter – Watch majestic eagles soaring and diving during the exciting eagle feeding stop at Singa Besar Island.
Beach Relaxation – Unwind on the soft white sands of Pulau Beras Basah with clear waters ideal for swimming and photos.
Scenic Speedboat Ride – Enjoy a thrilling island-hopping journey across Langkawi’s turquoise waters with panoramic views of limestone cliffs and lush islands.

globaltix_product_data.description: Spend the day exploring the world above and below the water with a visit to the state of the art Cairns Aquarium. This must-visit Cairns attraction is full of fun and adventure for all ages to enjoy, Cairns Aquarium will give you a look into the animals that live in both the rainforests and the oceans of Far North Queensland. With a visit here, you'll follow the journey of a drop of rain as it begins an adventure into our rivers and streams, our luscious rainforests, and of course, the beautiful Great Barrier Reef. With an emphasis on life underwater in Tropical North Queensland, there are ten different eco-systems showcasing a range of flora and fauna spread across 72 different habitats. With a number of different presentations throughout the day, including talks on River Monsters, the Ribbon Reef, the Open Ocean and Coral Sea Predators, you'll have a busy and fun day at the aquarium. There are also various Habitat Talks, animal feeding sessions and terrestrial and marine touch tanks that the kids will love. Home to over 16,000 aquatic animals, this is one of Queensland's biggest and best aquariums.

This tour is designed to combine cultural exploration with breathtaking natural beauty, culmi...
globaltix_product_data.description: The Temple of Poseidon & Cape Sounion Sunset Tour from Athens is a scenic half-day guided experience that takes visitors along the stunning Athenian Riviera to one of Greece’s most iconic coastal landmarks. This tour is designed to combine cultural exploration with breathtaking natural beauty, culminating in a memorable sunset view over the Aegean Sea. Guests will travel in a comfortable coach along the coastal road, passing through elegant seaside districts such as Glyfada, Vouliagmeni, and Varkiza, while enjoying panoramic views of the Saronic Gulf. Upon arrival at Cape Sounion, visitors will explore the ancient Temple of Poseidon, a Doric temple perched dramatically on a cliff, with fascinating insights from a professional guide about Greek mythology and history. The experience lasts approximately 4–5 hours and operates on a fixed afternoon-to-evening schedule. Guests meet at a central departure point and follow a structured itinerary. The highlight of the tour is witnessing the famous sunset over the Aegean Sea, offering a truly unforgettable atmosphere before returning to Athens.

Travel along the scenic Athens Riviera and enjoy stunning coastal views on the way to Cape Sounion.
Perfect for couples, photographers, and travelers seeking a romantic and scenic experience.
Includes round-trip transport, professional guide, headsets, and optional temple entrance ticket.
Visit the iconic Temple of Poseidon perched on a cliff overlooking the Aegean Sea.

globaltix_product_data.description: Visit Casa Batlló, one of the greatest jewels of Catalan modernism built by the architect Antoni Gaudí. globaltix_product_data.name: Guided Tour of the Seville Cathedral
globaltix_product_data.summary: The Cathedral of Seville is the largest Gothic cathedral in the world and one of the most architecturally magnificent and historically significant religious buildings in the whole of Spain — a UNESCO World Heritage monument of staggering scale, extraordinary artistic richness, and profound historica...
globaltix_product_data.description: The Cathedral of Seville is the largest Gothic cathedral in the world and one of the most architecturally magnificent and historically significant religious buildings in the whole of Spain — a UNESCO World Heritage monument of staggering scale, extraordinary artistic richness, and profound historical resonance that stands as the supreme achievement of Andalusian Christian civilisation on the site of the city's former great Almohad mosque. The Amigo Tours guided experience provides expert navigational and historical context through the cathedral's most significant and rewarding spaces — transforming what can be an overwhelming encounter with one of the world's largest religious buildings into a carefully curated and deeply engaging cultural journey. The guide leads guests through the cathedral's most celebrated treasures — the monumental tomb of Christopher Columbus carried by four royal pallbearers in sculpted bronze, the extraordinary main altarpiece of gilded carved wood that is the largest in the world, the Giralda tower with its distinctive Moorish minaret base and Renaissance upper section providing panoramic views across Seville from its summit, and the magnificent chapter house and sacristy containing works by Murillo, Zurbarán, and Goya from the cathedral's extraordinary art collection.
highlights: Stroll Through the Peaceful Patio de los Naranjos
Uncover Hidden Symbolism and Legends
Admire the Largest Gothic Cathedral in the World
Discover Christopher Columbus’ Tomb
Enjoy expert commentary from a professional licensed guide
Live bilingual commentary available in English and Spanish
Skip-the-line entrance tickets included — no queuing needed
inclusions: Entrance to Seville Cathedral and Giralda tower

globaltix_product_data.description: Chao Phraya Tourist Boat Co., Ltd. provides the original hop-on-hop-off boat service along Chao Phraya River, Bangkok, Thailand. The service has been established since 2003 by Chao Phraya Express Boat Co., Ltd., the leading public water transportation in Bangkok. Chao Phraya Tourist Boat Co., Ltd. established itself on 15th June, 2012 after separating from Chao Phraya Express Boat. Chao Phraya Tourist Boat runs the hop-on-hop-off boat service between 09.00 - 19.45 hrs from Sathorn Pier to Phra Arthit piers and 08.30 - 18.30 hrs from Phra Arthit piers to Sathorn Pier. Boats depart every 30 minutes from 9 piers, including: Sathorn Pier (BTS Saphan Taksin-S6), ICONSIAM Pier, Ratchawongse Pier, Rajinee Pier, Wat Arun Pier, Tha Chang Pier, Tha Maharaj Pier, Prannok Pier, Phra Arthit Pier. From 16.10 to 17.00 hrs, the route is extended to Asiatique as well.
highlights: Explore Bangkok at your own pace with our flexible hop-on-hop-off service.
Admire the breathtaking views of Bangkok's skyline and iconic landmarks as you journey along the Chao Phraya River.
Rest assured knowing that our boats operate with punctuality and efficiency.
Travel in comfort aboard our modern and well-equipped boats, featuring spacious seating areas, shaded decks, and onboard amenities.
Our hop-on-hop-off service in Bangkok lets you easily visit famous places like Wat Arun, the Grand Palace, Wat Pho, and bustling Chinatown markets.

globaltix_product_data.description: Stamford Bridge, the home of Chelsea Football Club, is not only a palace of sports competition, but also a place to showcase football culture. Visitors can follow the footsteps of professional Guide to explore this century-old stadium in depth and learn about the glorious history of Chelsea Football Club. The tour route includes the Changing room, player tunnel, coaching seats and other areas that are usually difficult to reach, allowing fans to experience the tense atmosphere of the match day up close. In addition, the museum houses many precious trophies, jerseys and historical photos, and vividly reproduces the glorious moments of the club through multimedia interactive exhibitions. Whether you are a veteran fan or a football culture enthusiast, you can find your own wonderful moments here.

globaltix_product_data.description: There are over 40 rides and attractions, plus a zoo and SEA LIFE Centre at Chessington. Get your Chessington tickets and meet a family of tigers, take to the vines like Tarzan, walk through an ocean tunnel, and loads more. Your Chessington tickets get you access to a spinning, looping, plummeting world of rides, including Vampire, Kobra, and Rattlesnake. Plus, don't miss Croc Drop for a thrilling 25-meter plunge into the jaws of a Nile Crocodile God! Feeling extra wild? Hang with over 1,000 exotic animals including gorillas, monkeys, lions and sea lions at the zoo. Swing through the trees and make like Tarzan at Go Ape. Ride the world's first Gruffalo ride, and get your kicks at 10 themed lands and over 40 rides at Chessington Theme Park. Meet a family of four endangered Amur tigers at Tiger Rock! Watch the big cats from the waterway. You can even look up at a big cat enclosure from Europe’s first overhead trails. At the SEA LIFE Centre explore interactive rock pools, watch the feeding sessions and stare a fish in the eyes on a walk through a huge ocean tunnel. With daily shows and activities, there's never a dull moment at Chessington!

globaltix_product_data.description: The Chiang Mai CAD Khomloy Sky Lantern Festival 2026 is one of the premier, largest, and most organized mass lantern release events in Northern Thailand. Hosted by Chiang Mai Arts and Design (CAD) at the sprawling CAD Cultural Center Lanna (located in the Mae On district), it serves as a massive cultural hub during the annual Yi Peng and Loy Krathong celebrations. The core purpose of the festival is to preserve, showcase, and promote the ancient Lanna (Northern Thai) heritage, transforming traditional rituals into a globally shared, breathtaking spectacle.
highlights: Official Dates: The festival will take place over two nights on November 24 and November 25, 2026.
The Big Highlight: Features a massive, coordinated release of over 10,000 eco-friendly sky lanterns alongside a large fireworks display
Cultural Experience: Includes a mock Lanna village, traditional northern Thai dance performances, tribal exhibitions
All-Inclusive Tickets: Every ticket includes entrance, 2 sky lanterns, 1 krathong, an unlimited Lanna Thai buffet dinner, and a souvenir package.
Included Transport: Packages provide round-trip shuttle transfers between designated city meeting points

The Elephant Jungle Sanctuary is renowned as one of the top elephant sanctuaries in Chiang Mai, with a proven commitment to sustainable and ethical treatment of elephants. Our Chiang Mai reserve offers a variety of ways for visitors to connect with the magnificent elephants of Thailand. For those interested in a half-day elephant tour, we provide enriching experiences. highlights: The Elephant Jungle Sanctuary is an ethical and sustainable eco-tourism project based in Thailand.
It was founded in July 2014 as a joint initiative between members of the Karen hill-tribes of Northern Thailand and Chiang Mai locals.
The sanctuary is located in 4 provinces throughout Thailand - Chiang Mai, Phuket, Pattaya, and Koh Samui.
They offer Half Day, Full Day, and Overnight Stay options to visit the sanctuary.
Visitors will have the opportunity to feed, bathe, and play with the elephants.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Experience the best of Chicago with a Premier Dinner Cruise and spend your evening on Lake Michigan with dining, picturesque views, DJ entertainment, and dancing. globaltix_product_data.description: Experience the best of Chicago with a Premier Dinner Cruise and spend your evening on Lake Michigan with dining, picturesque views, DJ entertainment, and dancing. While onboard, you’ll enjoy our chef-prepared plated menus, creative cocktails, distinctive service, and breathtaking views of Chicago’s skyline and attractions from our climate-controlled interior and open-air rooftop decks. Whether for a romantic dinner for two or for a special evening with friends and family, our dinner cruises are the perfect way to elevate any occasion and see Chicago from the water! To ensure your comfort, you get a guaranteed table that suits your party size, allowing you to relax and enjoy the company of your loved ones. Throughout the evening, complimentary coffee, hot tea, and iced tea are available to complement your dining experience. For those seeking an extra touch of indulgence, a fully stocked bar offers a wide selection of creative cocktails, wine, and beer for purchase. Secure a window table reservation to secure the best views and make your dinner cruise even more special. At checkout, you'll find additional upgrades that allow you to customize your experience to your preferences. Rest assured that climate-controlled interior decks provide a comfortable setting regardless of the weather, ensuring a pleasant dining environment for all. Additionally, infants under three years old are welcomed free of charge. Dietary restrictions are accommodated where possible. Meeting point: 600 East Grand Avenue, Chicago

globaltix_product_data.description: Come along and experience New Zealand’s longest lift and the only one that has been designed specifically for mountain bike riders. Enjoy the beautiful sights as you make your way up the 1.8km long lift for a scenic ride. The chairlift is 10 minute journey to the peak where you will be greeted with stunning views of Christchurch, the Pacific Ocean and the Southern Alps. The chairlift is used to reach the Zipline Tour or the Downhill Bike Ride but can also just be used for sightseeing. At the end of the ride there is a short walk to a viewing platform where you can take your time perfecting your selfies and enjoying the view. The chairlift runs everyday from 12pm- 7pm and can take up to 4 guests at one time. A full paying adult must accompany children 12 years and under or any child under 120cm.

globaltix_product_data.description: Take part in Christchurch's most iconic way to explore the city with a ride on its historic tram as you take in the informative commentary and great views! Featuring sightseeing with a dash of history mixed in, the Christchurch Tram is a long-running fixture of the city that takes you on an elegant and smooth ride to 17 important stops around Christchurch, and with this pass you'll have 24 hours with which to board and disembark at your leisure. A wide range of points of interest and historic architecture are covered on the Tram route, including the likes of the Avon River, Arts Centre, Canterbury Museum, Botanic Garden and much more. Featuring highly knowledgeable and enthusiastic drivers, it's one of the most enjoyable ways to gain an insight into this battered but not broken New Zealand city. In addition, the flexibility to hop on and hop off all day means you can make your individual Christchurch itinerary exactly how you like it, all coupled with a ride that is both informative and entertaining that adults and kids alike will enjoy. With a running time of every 15 - 20 minutes, this is Christchurch's best city sightseeing experience, so book your tram tickets online today!

globaltix_product_data.description: The London Eye is a giant observation wheel located on the South Bank of the River Thames, offering stunning panoramic views of London’s iconic landmarks. Standing at 135 meters tall, it is one of the world’s largest observation wheels. Visitors can enjoy a 30-minute ride in its spacious glass capsules, taking in breathtaking sights of the city, including Buckingham Palace, the Houses of Parliament, St. Paul’s Cathedral, and the Shard. It’s a perfect spot for sightseeing, photography, or simply enjoying a bird's-eye view of the capital. Whether day or night, the London Eye provides a unique perspective of the city’s skyline.
highlights: Standing at 135 meters, it's one of the world’s largest observation wheels, making it a must-see for visitors.
The glass capsules provide comfort and ample space, allowing visitors to move around and take in the scenery.
One of London’s most famous attractions, offering a stunning, 360-degree view of the city’s skyline.
Ideal for photography enthusiasts looking to capture London from a unique, elevated perspective.

globaltix_product_data.summary: In a city of immense and numerous charms, the canals just might be Amsterdam’s top draw. They’re everywhere and lend the city an elegant and laid back vibe. globaltix_product_data.description: In a city of immense and numerous charms, the canals just might be Amsterdam’s top draw. They’re everywhere and lend the city an elegant and laid back vibe. With this ticket you can explore the city by water over a 24-hour period and hop on and off at any of seven stops.The route takes in the old medieval core of Amsterdam where you should keep an eye out for old houses that literally lean forwards and tilt sideways (this city is built on a watery swamp). From there you’ll cruise to the broader expanses of the Grachtengordel.Now a UNESCO World Heritage Site, this is the ‘newer’ neighborhood that was built in the 17th century when Amsterdam’s intrepid traders brought back vast wealth from overseas journeys. They built three big canals that run parallel to each other in an impressive semi-circle.You might have noticed a theme – the city’s affinity for water, and a canal boat ride really is the most relaxing and elegant way to explore the city. However, the Dutch are famously pragmatic and the ticket allows you to navigate the city (okay, the captain is the one who’ll literally be navigating).Amsterdam is so compact and the network of canals so extensive that the entire city will be at your disposal. The route takes in stops such as the Rijksmuseum, the Anne Frank House and the Albert Cuyp Market (beloved by locals).Use the seven stops as a springboard to explore the city. You’ll have 24 hours to do so. Oh, and the most pragmatic touch of all? When you're on the water you get to avoid ALL the cyclists!

globaltix_product_data.summary: The London City Sightseeing Hop-On Hop-Off Bus is one of the most popular and convenient ways to explore the British capital, offering visitors the freedom to discover London's most iconic landmarks at their own pace aboard an open-top double-decker bus. Operated by City Sightseeing — one of the wor...
globaltix_product_data.description: The London City Sightseeing Hop-On Hop-Off Bus is one of the most popular and convenient ways to explore the British capital, offering visitors the freedom to discover London's most iconic landmarks at their own pace aboard an open-top double-decker bus. Operated by City Sightseeing — one of the world's leading hop-on hop-off bus tour operators — the service runs across multiple colour-coded routes that together cover over 60 stops spanning the full breadth of central London, from the grandeur of Buckingham Palace and Westminster to the historic riverside drama of the Tower of London and Tower Bridge. With buses running at frequent intervals throughout the day, guests can board and disembark freely at any stop along the route, spending as much or as little time as they wish at each attraction before hopping back aboard the next passing bus to continue their journey.Each bus is equipped with a multilingual pre-recorded audio commentary system available in up to 11 languages, delivering informative and engaging narration about the landmarks, history, and stories of London as the route unfolds. The open upper deck offers unobstructed panoramic views of the city skyline — particularly striking along the Embankment, across Westminster Bridge, and on the approach to St Paul's Cathedral — while the enclosed lower deck provides a comfortable alternative during cooler or wetter weather. Key landmarks covered across the route network include Buckingham Palace, the Houses of Parliament and Big Ben, Westminster Abbey, Trafalgar Square, Covent Garden, St Paul's Cathedral, the Tate Modern, Shakespeare's Globe, the Tower of London, Tower Bridge, the London Eye, and many more. Select ticket tiers also include entry to additional attractions, river cruise options, and walking tours as part of a bundled London experience package.
highlights: Multilingual audio commentary available in up to 11 languages, delivering rich historical and cultural narration throughout the entire route.
60+ stops across multiple colour-coded routes covering all of London's most iconic landmarks — explore freely at your own pace with no fixed itinerary.
Enjoy panoramic open-top views from the upper deck as the bus passes Buckingham Palace, Big Ben, Tower Bridge, and the London Eye.
Select ticket tiers include added value extras such as river cruise options, walking tours, and discounted entry to top London attractions.
Tickets valid for 24, 48, or 72 hours, allowing guests to spread their London exploration flexibly across one, two, or three full days.
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Tickets are available for Adults (16+), Children (5–15), and Family combinations. Children aged 4 and under travel free when accompanied by a paying adult. Tickets are valid for 1 or 2 consecutive days depending on the pass selected. The validity period begins upon first use at any boarding stop. Proof of age may be requested at boarding for child tickets. Guests unable to verify eligibility may be required to pay the full adult fare on board. Tickets are non-transferable and for single-user use only. Sharing a ticket between multiple guests is not permitted and may result in entry refusal. Discounted rates may be available for students, seniors, and groups of 10 or more. Group bookings must be made in advance through the official booking channel.

globaltix_product_data.description: Ride. Sip. Party. Only in Saigon! Step into the first-ever moving rooftop bar experience in Ho Chi Minh City! The Bar Bus Tour combines sightseeing, music, and drinks — all on a stylish double-decker bus cruising through Saigon’s dazzling nightlife. With city lights above, beats around you, and a drink in hand, this is not just a tour — it's a rolling party you won’t forget. Step aboard the Bar Bus — a moving rooftop party that takes you on a dazzling ride through the heart of Ho Chi Minh City at night. With a live DJ spinning upbeat tracks, neon lights dancing to the rhythm, and chilled drinks in hand, you'll cruise past iconic landmarks and hidden corners of the city in pure style. Whether you're looking to vibe with friends, celebrate a special night, or simply see the city from a whole new perspective, this is not your typical city tour — it's nightlife reimagined. Safe, vibrant, and unforgettable — the Bar Bus is where the city comes alive.

Create your own itinerary, hop off and back again at your leisure and discover one of the most beautiful cities in Spain.
