globaltix_product_data.description: Clark Safari and Adventure Park is a 40-hectare wildlife sanctuary located within the Clark Freeport Zone in Mabalacat City, Pampanga, Philippines. Home to over 1,500 animals across a wide range of species — including lions, tigers, bears, monkeys, reptiles, and exotic birds — the park offers an immersive, up-close experience with wildlife set against lush, forested surroundings. Beyond animal viewing, guests can enjoy safari truck rides through themed zones for a Jurassic World-style exploration experience, interactive animal encounters and feeding sessions, and adrenaline activities like zip lines offering scenic views across the park. The park also plays a conservation role as a rescue sanctuary, having taken in animals displaced by natural disasters and turned over by government wildlife authorities. Ideal for families, the park combines education, entertainment, and photo-worthy moments — from posing beside larger-than-life animal statues at the entrance to interactive up-close encounters with tiger cubs, horses, and farm animals.

globaltix_product_data.description: Start your Roman adventure with a timed entry to the iconic Colosseum, where you’ll step into one of the world’s most legendary arenas. As you walk through the ancient stone corridors, your digital audio guide shares gripping stories of gladiators, emperors, and roaring crowds that once filled the stands. Want to make it even more epic? Choose the Arena Floor upgrade and stand where the battles actually happened, right in the heart of the action. After exploring the Colosseum, take your time discovering Palatine Hill, the spot where Rome was founded and emperors built their palaces. Wander through ancient ruins and enjoy stunning views over the city. Then head down to the Roman Forum, once the center of Roman daily life. With your audio guide leading the way, imagine the bustling streets, lively debates, and market stalls that once filled this space. It’s a self-paced journey through the heart of Ancient Rome, with stories that bring every stone to life.

globaltix_product_data.description: Mozarthaus Vienna showcases the life and work of one of the world's most famous musical geniuses! Wander three exhibition levels spread across his old home, witness some of his creative achievements, and get a feel for the way he lived his life in 16th-century Vienna.Explore the only preserved apartment of his in Vienna over three levels, each offering different exhibitions about his life and work. Mozart lived in this elegant house from 1784 to 1787 and composed more of his music here than anywhere else. You'll tour four large rooms, two small ones, and a kitchen. You'll no doubt imagine Mozart with his wig and frilly-collar-wearing family in each one. With your free audio guide, you'll also hear some of his most important works. Even if you think you don't know much of his music, we bet you'll recognize a lot! The years Mozart spent in Vienna are considered the peak of his creative achievements. This is a must-see not just for Mozart fans, but for all music fans. He's one of the greats. Go visit him at home.

globaltix_product_data.summary: The Guided Tour to Sagrada Família and Park Güell combines Barcelona's two most celebrated and architecturally extraordinary creations of Antoni Gaudí in a single expertly managed day that delivers the full scope of the visionary Catalan architect's unique and unprecedented contribution to world arc...
globaltix_product_data.description: The Guided Tour to Sagrada Família and Park Güell combines Barcelona's two most celebrated and architecturally extraordinary creations of Antoni Gaudí in a single expertly managed day that delivers the full scope of the visionary Catalan architect's unique and unprecedented contribution to world architecture. Both sites are UNESCO World Heritage properties — the Sagrada Família basilica representing Gaudí's spiritual and architectural masterpiece in its most ambitious and monumental form, and Park Güell the most playful, colourful, and nature-inspired expression of his decorative genius in a garden and public space of extraordinary originality. The expert Amigo Tours guide provides the biographical and architectural context that makes both sites fully comprehensible and deeply rewarding — covering Gaudí's creative philosophy, his synthesis of natural forms and Gothic structural principles, his deeply personal Catholic faith, and the specific design decisions at both sites that reflect the full depth of his architectural vision. All tickets are pre-secured by Amigo Tours for both attractions — eliminating the significant challenge of independent procurement for two of Barcelona's most popular and strictly capacity-controlled sites and ensuring a seamlessly structured and genuinely enriching full Gaudí day in the Catalan capital.

Spend free time at the medieval Saxon town of Brasov
Get spooked by Gothic Bran Castle, also known as Dracula's Castle
Enjoy a full-day tour to Transylvania from Bucharest

globaltix_product_data.description: “Have I really been here for three hours?” - this might be the only question left unanswered after your visit to this brand new attraction in the heart of Amsterdam. There’s so much to see and do that you’ll wish you had four eyes, like a certain Chinese gentleman you'll meet. Step into this delightful time sink - and good luck with that @#$%&! mystery gate!Robert Ripley toured the world, returning with surprising information and peculiar artifacts. At Ripley’s Believe It or Not Amsterdam you can benefit from his years of hard work as you wander the five floors of (nearly) unbelievable artifacts. Start at the entrance, by taking a selfie with the world’s tallest man. And then dive deeper and deeper into a comprehensive collection of fascinating oddities. From a Ghanese coffin in the shape of a flying car, to an intricate sculpture made entirely of cutlery, this exhibition will beguile, baffle and delight. Plus, if you’re scared of the dentist, the terrifying 19th century tooth extractor will show just how good you have it! Altogether, there are more than 500 exhibits and artifacts organized in 19 themed galleries - but don't worry, there's a clear path guiding you through the building. You can spend as much time as you want analyzing the contents of each room before moving to the next one. Learn how to shrink a human head in the jungle gallery, then go to the creepy chamber (unless you're too chicken) and see which torture enthusiast inspired Bram Stoker to create Count Dracula.Whether you’re familiar with curator Robert Ripley’s legacy or not, this place will grab your attention and hold onto it for hours. Say hello to weirdness, and goodbye to whatever else you had planned for the afternoon.

globaltix_product_data.description: TeamLab Planets TOKYO is a one-of-a-kind immersive art museum where visitors walk through water, become part of digital artworks, and engage with vibrant, interactive installations. This breathtaking exhibition, created by the renowned art collective TeamLab, blends art, technology, and nature to create a surreal, multi-sensory experience.
highlights: Infinity Spaces: Enter rooms filled with mirrored surfaces and dazzling lights that create a boundless, dreamlike atmosphere.
Walk Through Water: Step into mesmerizing digital environments, including a vast water installation that responds to movement.
Floating Flower Garden: Experience a stunning installation where flowers move and surround you as you walk.
Interactive Artworks: Engage with large-scale digital projections that shift and transform based on your presence.
Sensory Immersion: The exhibits engage all five senses, making the experience truly unforgettable.
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Once the admission ticket is activated, it is for personal use only and cannot be resold or shared by multiple people at the same time You are not allowed to re-enter the venue after leaving admission ticket are only valid on the fixed-date. You will not be able to enter without a voucher. Please note that it may take 30-60 minutes to enter the venue; if there is a delay, please wait patiently Wheelchair users must use the wheelchairs provided by the exhibition hall when entering the venue; the number of wheelchairs provided on site is limited and they are standard models without special accessories Please be barefoot in some areas to experience the artwork. Please remove your shoes when entering the locker space.The water depth of the exhibits can reach the knee level of an adult. One of the exhibition areas is a mirrored space. If you wear a skirt or wide pants, there is a risk of exposure. It is recommended to wear pants when visiting the exhibition We are not responsible for any personal injury, loss or other problems caused by the facilities during the exhibition. The exhibition facilities are complex and pets such as guide dogs are not allowed to enter. Small lockers are available for free use on site. Locker size is 23cm (W) x 34cm (D) x 37cm (H). Please note that some exhibits have flashing lights or loud sound effects. Admission control: In order to disperse the crowds of visitors, teamLab Planets TOKYO will open pre-sale e-tickets for fixed-date and times (each 30 minutes is a time slot). In addition, the number of admission ticket and the number of visitors provided in each time slot will be limited to avoid overcrowding after reopening. Please wear a mask. Everyone is encouraged to follow proper cough etiquette and wash hands frequently or use alcohol disinfectant. Alcohol sprayers are available in many places in the venue. Please feel free to use them. Ventilation and air conditioning equipment in the museum is open 24 hours a day to strengthen cleaning and disinfection operations in the museum "Sunrise and Sunset" exhibition: In case of light rain, the exhibition will remain open for visitors; in case of heavy rain and strong winds such as typhoons, the exhibition may be cancelled Prohibitions & RestrictionsNo outside food or drinks allowed It is prohibited to bring dangerous items such as bottles, firecrackers, lasers, etc. that may disturb or cause inconvenience to other spectators into the venue Smoking and drinking are prohibited. Once found by the staff, you will be asked to leave immediately. You can take photos on site, but filming and live streaming for commercial purposes are strictly prohibited AccessibilityThis activity is not suitable for infant This activity is wheelchair accessible Please refer to the official website for the latest terms of use and precautions. https://www.teamlab.art/e/planets/#notion

options.name: TeamLab Planets TOKYO Admission Ticket
options.description: The teamLab Planets TOKYO is an immersive digital art museum located in Tokyo, Japan, offering a one-of-a-kind sensory experience where visitors become part of the artwork. Created by the renowned art collective teamLab, this attraction blends technology, light, water, and space to create interactive installations that engage all five senses. It is a must-visit destination for art lovers and travelers seeking a futuristic and Instagram-worthy experience. Operation Hours: Daily, 08.30 - 22.00 Location : 6-1-16 Toyosu, Koto City, Tokyo
options.termsAndConditions: Entry may require a 30–90 minute wait. Tickets are non-refundable, non-cancellable, and non-transferable. Resale tickets are invalid. Student tickets may require valid student ID. No re-entry after exit. Please arrive early and queue according to your ticket admission time (admission time is not a time limit). Children under 13 must be accompanied by an adult aged 18 or above. Pregnant visitors may be unable to experience certain artworks. Wheelchair users are welcome; some water exhibits are inaccessible and designated wheelchairs must be used (limited availability). Some exhibits include strong lighting, dark spaces, mirrored floors, and water up to knee level. Water areas require barefoot entry; shoes and socks must be removed. Clothing may get wet; bringing a change of clothes is recommended. Wet clothing is not permitted in subsequent exhibits. Free safety shorts and shoe rentals are available on-site. Personal belongings are not allowed inside exhibit areas. Free lockers are available (23 × 34 × 37 cm). Oversized luggage will be stored in the stroller parking area. Baby carriers are allowed; diaper-changing stations and a first aid room are available. Staff may guide visitors to exit during peak crowd conditions. Photography and interviews may occur inside the venue. Some artworks may be unavailable due to operational or weather conditions. The operator is not responsible for injury, loss, or theft. Visitors asked to leave for rule violations are not eligible for refunds. Prohibited: intoxicated or disruptive behavior, eating or smoking inside the venue, dangerous items, commercial photography without approval, and animals including assistance dogs.
howToUse: Show Mobile Ticket: at the entrance

Be transported by adrenaline-pumping rides, interactive shows and a wide variety of exciting attractions based on the blockbuster movies and television series you know and love so well. Welcome in and enjoy the ride!
highlights: New York: Walk the sidewalks of the Big Apple and experience the energy of NYC, just as you've seen it in the movies.
Sci-Fi City: Explore this action-packed futuristic metropolis, home to adrenaline rides
Ancient Egypt: Step back into 1920s Egypt and explore ancient obelisks, the riddles of the Sphinx and curse-ridden rides.
The Lost World: Walk with dinosaurs in Jurassic Park and watch death-defying stunts at WaterWorld's sensational water show.
Far Far Away: Step into the fairytale kingdom of Far Far Away with castles, green ogres, a talking donkey and magic potions.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Get priority access to this former palace and riverside prison on Paris's medieval Île de la Cité. globaltix_product_data.description: Get priority access to this former palace and riverside prison on Paris's medieval Île de la Cité. You’ll see prison cells from the French Revolution (including the cell of Queen Marie Antoinette), and the Gothic is Europe’s biggest medieval hall still in existence.History is soaked into the thick walls of this incredible Gothic building. Built as a royal palace in the 14th century, when the royal family decamped for fancier surroundings in the Louvre and Vincennes, it found new life as a prison. During the French Revolution it earned the chilling nickname "the antechamber to the guillotine". People accused of being an enemy of the republic would face a tribunal in the Great Hall, where they would either be acquitted, or found guilty of treason and sentenced to death. If convicted they would await their fate in one of the nearby cells. The wealthy would pay for relatively comfortable rooms with beds, while commoners were crammed into plague-infested haybed cells.The most famous resident during its stint as a prison was Queen Marie Antoinette. After the Restoration, her cell was converted into a chapel. A visit to her lockup is one of the highlights of a trip to this famous building. Other attractions include Europe's largest medieval hall, the , and the dreaded Bonbec Tower, which was a torture chamber. The name 'Bonbec' refers to the fact that prisoners who came here would confess to whatever they were being accused of ( means 'good' and meant 'mouth').A visit to the Conciergerie is a fascinating glimpse into the turbulent history of the French Republic. And unlike many of its residents, you're allowed to leave afterwards! The Conciergerie's past as a tribunal lives on in the present - parts of it now house the Paris Law Courts.
highlights: Wander through the Salle des Gens d’Armes, the former dining room for 2,000 palace staff,and Europe's largest existing medieval hall
The dramatic history of the famous Conciergerie includes life as both a palace and riverside prison fortress. Note the varied decor from its different lives
inclusions: Histopad, available until 16:30 in French, English, Spanish, German, Italian and Chinese

globaltix_product_data.description: Visita guiada dedicada al monumento insigne de Córdoba, la Mezquita-Catedral, declarada Patrimonio de la Humanidad por la UNESCO. En esta visita, realizada siempre por un historiador, tendrán la ocasión de conocer un templo vivo, que ha sido testigo de numerosos hechos históricos y que, a buen seguro, no les dejará indiferente. Les explicaremos las distintas etapas constructivas, partiendo de la antigua Basílica Visigoda de San Vicente, siguiendo por la Primitiva Mezquita que construyera el Emir Abderramán I y sus sucesivas ampliaciones hasta la época de Almanzor. Disfrute de un edificio único en el mundo y de una experiencia inolvidable. Después, pasearemos por el famoso Barrio Judío, donde conoceremos la Sinagoga, el Zoco Municipal de los Artesanos y el Monumento a Maimónides.

Enjoy a well-organised itinerary that makes the most of your time

Perfect for travellers who want to explore beyond the usual highlights

globaltix_product_data.description: Visita guiada dedicada al monumento insigne de Córdoba, la Mezquita-Catedral, declarada Patrimonio de la Humanidad por la UNESCO. En esta visita, realizada siempre por un historiador, tendrán la ocasión de conocer un templo vivo, que ha sido testigo de numerosos hechos históricos y que, a buen seguro, no les dejará indiferente. Les explicaremos las distintas etapas constructivas, partiendo de la antigua Basílica Visigoda de San Vicente, siguiendo por la Primitiva Mezquita que construyera el Emir Abderramán I y sus sucesivas ampliaciones hasta la época de Almanzor. Disfrute de un edificio único en el mundo y de una experiencia inolvidable. Después, pasearemos por el famoso Barrio Judío, donde conoceremos la Sinagoga, el Zoco Municipal de los Artesanos y el Monumento a Maimónides.
highlights: Visit the spectacular Mosque-Cathedral of Córdoba
Enjoy a well-organised itinerary that makes the most of your time
Discover one of Spain's most iconic experiences with an expert local guide
Create lasting memories at some of the region's most celebrated sights
Perfect for travellers who want to explore beyond the usual highlights

globaltix_product_data.summary: Crocodile Adventureland is home to around 4,000 young and mature species of crocodile, including Tomistoma, Siamese, Guinea, and the Saltwater Crocodile. The farm is also home to 'Bujang Lang', one of the world's largest crocodiles in captivity weighing in at 1,000 kilograms. Engage in several activ...
globaltix_product_data.description: Crocodile Adventureland is home to around 4,000 young and mature species of crocodile, including Tomistoma, Siamese, Guinea, and the Saltwater Crocodile. The farm is also home to 'Bujang Lang', one of the world's largest crocodiles in captivity weighing in at 1,000 kilograms. Engage in several activities including crocodile feeding and fishing, and come virtually face to face with life sized, crocodile like dinosaurs, in an interactive experience powered by animatronics technology.
highlights: Largest Collection of Crocodiles: The park is home to nearly 4000 crocodiles from various species such as Tomistoma, Siamese, Guinea, and Saltwater crocodile.
Educational and Entertaining: The park combines entertainment & education, featuring live shows that highlight the strength and agility of these reptiles.
Interactive Activities: The park offers interactive activities such as juvenile crocodile fishing and feeding.
Awards and Recognition: ‘Outstanding Eco Adventure Park’ by MyMalaysia Tourism in 2023.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Cu Chi underground tunnels: Located 70km from Ho Chi Minh City, Cu Chi is now considered a heroic district for its role during the American war in Vietnam. It is legendary for its network of tunnels, which extend over 200km, and is a popular destination for both Vietnamese and foreign visitors. Jour...
globaltix_product_data.description: Cu Chi underground tunnels: Located 70km from Ho Chi Minh City, Cu Chi is now considered a heroic district for its role during the American war in Vietnam. It is legendary for its network of tunnels, which extend over 200km, and is a popular destination for both Vietnamese and foreign visitors. Journey through a chapter in Vietnamese history on a tour of the network of underground rooms used by the Viet Cong during the war.  Your day starts at 8:00 AM with a hotel pick-up in Saigon. You'll head to Cu Chi, a 1.5-hour bus journey. Upon arrival at 9:30 AM, you'll get an introduction and watch a video about tunnel construction and wartime strategies. The highlight is exploring the tunnels with various facilities. Afterward, enjoy special tea and cassava, the guerilla's food. You can relax or try shooting a real gun. The trip ends at 3:00 PM as you return to Saigon.
highlights: Explore the Viet Cong tunnels, gaining insight into Vietnam War history and the soldiers' tactics with the tunnels over 200km.
Witness demonstrations of guerrilla warfare tactics and traps used during the conflict.
Learn about the soldiers' daily life through informative exhibits within the tunnels.
Enjoy picturesque countryside views on the journey to and from the tunnels.
Join in tour with a group of 25 pax.

Mandai Gallery

Mandai Gallery is a permanent exhibition that celebrates the rich history and transformation of Mandai Wildlife Reserve—from its humble beginnings as a zoo to its evolution into a world-class wildlife and nature destination. The exhibition showcases our contributions to nation-building, commitment to sustainability, and efforts in wildlife conservation both locally and regionally.

Through immersive multimedia displays, guests can hear from our keepers and wildlife experts about animal care and conservation initiatives that support a thriving natural world. Mandai Gallery invites visitors to reflect on this journey and be inspired to join us in protecting wildlife for a sustainable future.

Complimentary Access

  • Visitors with a Destination Pass, or admission tickets to Curiosity Cove or any of the wildlife parks at Mandai Wildlife Reserve will enjoy complimentary access to Mandai Gallery

Location & Operating Hours

  • Mandai Gallery is located in the same building as Curiosity Cove and is open daily from 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM.

STB-Licensed Tourist Guide / Tour Leader Complimentary Admission

Complimentary Admission Eligibility:

1. STB-Licensed Tourist Guides

 

  • Tourist guides holding a valid Singapore Tourism Board (STB) Tourist Guide licence are entitled to complimentary admission upon presentation of their valid licence at the point of entry, subject to verification.

 

2. Tour Leaders

 

  • One (1) complimentary ticket will be issued for every fifteen (15) paying guests.
  • A maximum of four (4) complimentary tickets may be issued per tour group.

 

Advance Registration Requirements:

3. Complimentary admission for Tour Leaders must be requested in advance.

4. Proof of identity for each Tour Leader and the group booking order must be submitted to the Reservations Team at least three (3) working days before the group's visit date.

5. Complimentary tickets will be issued via the Reseller Portal before the group's arrival.

6. Tour Leaders must present the complimentary ticket at the entrance for admission.


Admission Conditions:

7. Admission is subject to verification and approval by the operator.

8. The operator reserves the right to refuse or limit entry if the eligibility requirements are not met.

9. Complimentary Tour Leader tickets are based on a minimum of fifteen (15) paying guests for the same park within a single transaction. Multiple parks or separate transactions cannot be combined for qualification purposes.

 

Exclusions

10. Complimentary admission to Rainforest Wild ASIA does not include access to paid activities under Adventure Plus and Black Adventure.

11. Complimentary admission to River Wonders does not include access to paid activities, including the Amazon River Quest ride.

globaltix_product_data.summary: This isn’t the kind of museum where you just read and look – you’re actively experiencing what it was like to live in the DDR (Deutsche Demokratische Republik). There are hundreds of unique artifacts from Germany’s Socialist past on display and visitors are encouraged to get involved. Skip the line...
globaltix_product_data.description: This isn’t the kind of museum where you just read and look – you’re actively experiencing what it was like to live in the DDR (Deutsche Demokratische Republik). There are hundreds of unique artifacts from Germany’s Socialist past on display and visitors are encouraged to get involved. Skip the line into Germany's Socialist past.Living under communism wasn't easy, and this museum lets you appreciate that, by experiencing Stasi surveillance firsthand, watching East German TV shows, and voting in a (rigged) election.The experience covers well-known East Berlin topics like the Stasi and the Wall, and into the everyday life for people living by the DDR’s rules. You'll feel that bleak day-to-day as you wander a very real-feeling Communist-era apartment in an anonymous high-rise. It ain’t pretty, but it sure is fascinating.True to their commitment to a complete experience: you exit the museum through a piece of the Berlin Wall. Outside the wall, you'll have a new appreciation for the fresh air of freedom.The DDR Museum has twice been nominated as the European Museum of the Year - which is pretty good for a museum that's only been open since 2006!

globaltix_product_data.name: Small-Group Delphi One Day Tour
globaltix_product_data.summary: The Small Group Delphi One Day Guided Tour by Key Tours is one of Greece's most rewarding and historically profound single-day excursions — a comprehensive guided journey from Athens to the sacred sanctuary of Delphi, one of the ancient world's most spiritually significant and archaeologically extra...
globaltix_product_data.description: The Small Group Delphi One Day Guided Tour by Key Tours is one of Greece's most rewarding and historically profound single-day excursions — a comprehensive guided journey from Athens to the sacred sanctuary of Delphi, one of the ancient world's most spiritually significant and archaeologically extraordinary sites, set dramatically on the slopes of Mount Parnassus in central Greece with sweeping views across the olive-covered valley of Phocis to the Gulf of Corinth far below. Departing from central Athens in a comfortable air-conditioned coach, the small group format ensures an intimate and genuinely personalised experience — the expert Key Tours guide delivering rich historical and mythological commentary throughout the journey and across every section of the Delphi archaeological site, transforming what might otherwise be a confusing labyrinth of ancient ruins into a coherent and deeply absorbing narrative of one of the most important places in the history of Western civilisation. Delphi was considered by the ancient Greeks to be the omphalos — the navel of the world — and served for centuries as the most important oracle sanctuary in the Greek world, where the Pythia priestess of Apollo delivered cryptic prophecies that shaped the decisions of kings, city-states, and armies across the Mediterranean. The tour encompasses the full Delphi archaeological site — the Sacred Way lined with treasuries, the magnificent Temple of Apollo, the ancient Theatre with its panoramic valley views, and the Stadium where the Pythian Games were held — as well as the outstanding Delphi Archaeological Museum, whose extraordinary collection of sanctuary offerings, sculpture, and bronze masterworks provides the essential complement to the outdoor site visit. The charming nearby town of Arachova, perched dramatically above the valley on the slopes of Parnassus, provides the day's most authentically Greek village experience during the included lunch stop.

globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Ticket Eligibility This is a small group guided tour open to individuals, couples, families, and small groups with an interest in ancient Greek history, mythology, and archaeology. Child pricing may apply for participants under a specified age. Accurate ages must be provided at the time of booking to ensure correct ticket classification and site entry. The tour is conducted in English by a licensed expert guide. Group sizes are intentionally kept small to ensure a personalised and high-quality experience at each site. Advance booking is strongly recommended as group capacity is strictly limited. Key Tours reserves the right to cancel departures with insufficient participant numbers. A valid booking confirmation must be presented at the designated Athens pickup point. Failure to show valid confirmation may result in entry to the tour being denied. Attraction Access The full-day tour departs from Athens and visits the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Delphi — home to the ancient Sanctuary of Apollo, the Temple of Apollo, and the Sacred Way. Highlights include the Delphi Archaeological Museum, the ancient Theatre, the Athenian Treasury, and the legendary Oracle of Delphi site set dramatically on the slopes of Mount Parnassus. The tour includes a scenic drive through the Greek countryside, passing through Boeotia and the historic town of Arachova — one of Greece's most picturesque mountain villages. Entrance fees to the Delphi Archaeological Site and Museum are included as specified at booking. Any optional experiences or personal purchases are payable separately on the day. The operator reserves the right to modify the itinerary or visit order due to site conditions, crowd levels, or operational factors beyond their reasonable control on the day. Additional Information The Delphi Archaeological Site involves significant uphill walking on uneven ancient stone surfaces. Comfortable, flat-soled walking shoes are essential for all participants. Guests with mobility limitations, heart conditions, or difficulty with uneven terrain should inform the operator at booking to confirm their suitability for the site visit. A dress code of respect applies at religious or sacred areas within the Delphi site. Modest clothing is recommended; shoulders and knees should be covered where required. Lunch is not included in the standard package. The tour includes a break in Arachova or Delphi village where guests may dine independently at local restaurants. Photography for personal non-commercial use is welcome throughout the site and museum, subject to any specific restrictions posted at individual exhibit areas within the museum.

Departing from central Athens in a comfortable air-conditioned coach, the small group format ensures an intimate and genuinely personalised experience — the expert Key Tours guide delivering rich historical and mythological commentary throughout the journey and across every section of the Delphi archaeological site, transforming what might otherwise be a confusing labyrinth of ancient ruins into a coherent and deeply absorbing narrative of one of the most important places in the history of Western civilisation. Meeting Points: Key Tours offices at 08:00 am. Address: 26, Athanasiou Diakou, 11743, Athens
options.termsAndConditions: Ticket Eligibility This is a small group guided tour open to individuals, couples, families, and small groups with an interest in ancient Greek history, mythology, and archaeology. Child pricing may apply for participants under a specified age. Accurate ages must be provided at the time of booking to ensure correct ticket classification and site entry. The tour is conducted in English by a licensed expert guide. Group sizes are intentionally kept small to ensure a personalised and high-quality experience at each site. Advance booking is strongly recommended as group capacity is strictly limited. Key Tours reserves the right to cancel departures with insufficient participant numbers. A valid booking confirmation must be presented at the designated Athens pickup point. Failure to show valid confirmation may result in entry to the tour being denied. Attraction Access The full-day tour departs from Athens and visits the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Delphi — home to the ancient Sanctuary of Apollo, the Temple of Apollo, and the Sacred Way. Highlights include the Delphi Archaeological Museum, the ancient Theatre, the Athenian Treasury, and the legendary Oracle of Delphi site set dramatically on the slopes of Mount Parnassus. The tour includes a scenic drive through the Greek countryside, passing through Boeotia and the historic town of Arachova — one of Greece's most picturesque mountain villages. Entrance fees to the Delphi Archaeological Site and Museum are included as specified at booking. Any optional experiences or personal purchases are payable separately on the day. The operator reserves the right to modify the itinerary or visit order due to site conditions, crowd levels, or operational factors beyond their reasonable control on the day. Additional Information The Delphi Archaeological Site involves significant uphill walking on uneven ancient stone surfaces. Comfortable, flat-soled walking shoes are essential for all participants. Guests with mobility limitations, heart conditions, or difficulty with uneven terrain should inform the operator at booking to confirm their suitability for the site visit. A dress code of respect applies at religious or sacred areas within the Delphi site. Modest clothing is recommended; shoulders and knees should be covered where required. Lunch is not included in the standard package. The tour includes a break in Arachova or Delphi village where guests may dine independently at local restaurants. Photography for personal non-commercial use is welcome throughout the site and museum, subject to any specific restrictions posted at individual exhibit areas within the museum.

globaltix_product_data.description: The word DEVDAN comes from Sanskrit 'Deva' and 'Dhana', meaning "God's Grace". Indonesia's treasure are God's gifts for Indonesia people. The DEVDAN story begins when two young children who are parts of a tourist group in Bali feel bored with the tour itinerary and set themselves apart from the group to climb toward a cliff that has grabbed their attention. They find a treasure chest containing various unique items that will bring them, and the audience, in their magical journey to the islands of Bali, Sumatera, Java, Kalimantan, and Papua begins.
highlights: Devdan showcases a variety of traditional dances, music, and rituals from different regions across Indonesia.
The show incorporates state-of-the-art lighting, sound, and special effects to create an immersive and unforgettable experience for the audience.
Devdan weaves together an engaging narrative that follows the journey of two young children who discover the beauty and wonder of Indonesia's cultural treasures

globaltix_product_data.description: Check three items off your Paris bucket-list and make the most of your time in Paris. Begin your evening with a dinner cruise through the heart of the city. Afterward, make your way to the 2nd floor of the Eiffel Tower with your skip-the-line pass and soak up stunning views before heading to the famed Moulin Rouge for an exciting night of cabaret. La Marina Dinner Cruise, Eiffel Tower by Night, and Moulin Rouge Show Highlights Enjoy a relaxing dinner cruise as you float along the Seine River and take in stunning sights of landmarks including the Louvre Museum, Notre Dame de Paris Cathedral, Conciergerie, Orsay Museum and much more. With your priority access pass, skip-the-line to the 2nd floor of the Eiffel Tower and take in incredible views of the city at night. Afterward, head to the Moulin Rouge for an unforgettable evening of outstanding cabaret. Step into the world of rhinestones, feathers and sequins for a truly enchanting experience! Witness the French can-can come to life as you sip champagne in this beloved Parisian nightlife hotspot. Why You Shouldnâ€™t Miss This Make the most of your time in Paris with a 3-in-1 tour package to some of the most sought after Parisian experiences. Enjoy a charming dinner on the famous floating restaurant, La Marina de Paris. Afterward, head to the Eiffel Tower, where your skip-the-line ticket will give you priority access to the 2nd floor. Take in the unique views of the French capital from 377 feet up! Last, but certainly not least, head to the legendary Moulin Rouge. Situated at the heart of the lively Montmartre district, the world-famous cabaret attracts over 600,000 spectators a year! Watch the theatreâ€™s current show, "Feerie", and witness the Moulin Rougeâ€™s talented troupe of 80 performers in a stunning, colorful stage performance. About Your La Marina Dinner Cruise, Eiffel Tower by Night, and Moulin Rouge Show Experience Head to the central Paris meeting point and board an AC motor coach for a 6 pm departure to the banks of the Seine River. Embark on a charming one hour and fifteen minute dinner cruise aboard the floating restaurant, La Marina. Enjoy stunning views of the city as you float along one of the most beautiful boulevards in Paris. Pass by the Orsay Museum, the Conciergerie, Notre Dame Cathedral, the Louvre Museum, the Eiffel Tower and more. Next, visit the Eiffel Tower and take in the unique views of the French capital from 377 feet up! Your skip-the-line ticket will give you priority access to the 2nd floor, saving you the hassle of a long wait. Lastly, board your motor coach and head to the legendary Moulin Rouge. Sit back and relax as you enjoy the 2 hour long production featuring over talented performers from around the world. Be amazed by the exceptional routines and numbers set against the backdrop of an original musical score played and recorded by 80 musicians. You will be taken back to your Paris accommodation after the show via motor coach. globaltix_product_data.description: Dinner in the Sky gives you once-in-the-lifetime chance to enjoy dining in a massive revolving platform that is suspended 50 meters (165 feet) in the sky. This not only lets you dine in an exceptionally safe and intimate setting (with your group of up to 22 people), but also feasts you with the most incredible 360 degree views over the city’s legendary sights across Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Marina, and more. Overall, it promises you a dining and sightseeing adventure worth remembering forever.
highlights: Treat yourself to an exclusive sky-high lunch, dinner or afternoon sea served 50 meters (about 165 feet) above the cityscape.
Enjoy unmatched food and sensational sights in an unrivaled setting as your table gently rotates throughout this mid-air session.
Join for the most exciting and unforgettable culinary tour with this dining adventure in the sky.
Get the most spellbinding 360 degree views over Dubai’s icons including Burj Al Arab, Burj Khalifa, Palm Jumeirah and Dubai Marina during the experience.

options.name: Dinner in the Sky - Dinner (All Days)
options.description: Take to the Sky Make your way to the location at Skydive Dubai (Al Sufouh) and strap yourself to the seat before being gently lifted by a crane to a height of about 50 meters. Recline in your comfortable chair and enjoy the sensation of your feet dangling in the air as you take in unhindered views of the city skyline. The table and seats gently spin during the 90-minute dining experience, offering incredible views of landmarks like Burj Al Arab, Burj Khalifa, Palm Jumeirah, and Dubai Marina. Indulge in a Gastronomic Experience like No Other This aerial venue can seat up to 22 people at a time. It serves a three-course meal or sweet/savory treat, depending on whether you choose lunch, dinner, or an afternoon tea break. The menu includes both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options, all prepared live in front of you. Combining delicious food and stunning views, it’s no surprise that Forbes listed Dinner in the Sky among the world’s 10 most unusual restaurants. Dine & Capture Treasured Moments with Absolute Safety Perfect for a first date, celebrating a special occasion, or treating friends to an extraordinary experience. This Belgium-originated concept complies with the German safety norm DIN 4112. It operates under the strict guidelines of the UAE’s Department of Occupational Safety & Health and Civil Defense. All safety measures ensure a pleasant and secure airborne dining adventure from start to finish.

Smoking is strictly prohibited during the Dinner in the Sky experience. Once the platform has been lifted, the organizer will not lower it for attire or shoe changes. options.name: Disneyland Park California 2-Day 1-Park Ticket + Disney Lightning Lane Multi Pass
options.description: In 1955, Walt, the father of Disney, built California Disneyland in Los Angeles, which is the world's first original Disney theme park. The park is located within the California Disney Resort. There are two main parks: Disneyland Park and Disney California Adventure Park. The two parks are adjacent to each other. Visitors can visit both parks at one time and experience the joyful magic of Disney World. Come and enter the land of fairy tales and meet classic characters such as Mickey, Minnie, Disney princesses, Avengers, and Star Wars heroes.Location: Disneyland Dr, Anaheim, CA Operation Hours 08:00 - 23:00(Operating hours may change, please refer to the official website for the most updated information.)
options.termsAndConditions: Two-day ticket (reservation required for each day) Before placing your order, please check the attraction availability at disneytraveltradeinfo.com/dlrcalendar and proceed with your booking only after confirming availability. After placing your order, go to StartYourDisneylandExperience.com to register, link, and reserve your account. How to link: Select Parks & Tickets > Select Ticket and Reservation Details > Select Make Park Reservation > Select Book Theme Park Reservation > Select Link a ticket or Magic Key Pass > Enter the Ticket# or the number under the QR code. Please note that linking and booking can only be done on the website, not in the app. If your purchase includes a fast pass, it will also be linked when you link your account. Visitors who have booked the Disney Lightning Lane Multi Pass (formerly Disney Genie+) can use their ticket to access the Lightning Lane for attractions or experiences in the theme park on the day of their visit. Pass holders can select only one attraction or experience at a time and choose their fast pass options on the day of entry. Some attractions or experiences do not support the Lightning Lane Multi Pass (formerly Disney Genie+) service, and daily reservation slots are limited and subject to availability. Only one arrival window per attraction or experience can be selected each day. Pass holders must download the Disneyland Park California app (Disneyland) before entering the park to use this pass, as the user service interface is available in English only. Photos from the Disney PhotoPass One Day Pass must be downloaded before their expiration date. All photos and other digital content are subject to the expiration policy. Attraction times may change at any time, so please check the app in advance. The attraction reserves the right to modify operational requirements due to changes in operating hours, attraction closures, or park shutdowns. This pass is non-transferable and non-refundable. Visitors under 14 must be accompanied by a visitor aged 14 or above to enter the theme park. Children under 7 must be accompanied by someone aged 14 or above to board the rides. Other park rules apply. Unused admission tickets can be canceled at any time. However, if one ticket in a group booking remains unused while others have been used, the unused ticket becomes non-refundable. To avoid refund issues, consider booking tickets separately if there's a cancellation risk. Please note that any modifications made independently through the official website or at the attraction (such as upgrades) will make the ticket ineligible for refunds or changes. Opening hours may be adjusted at any time. Please check the official website before your trip to confirm the opening hours on your visit day. Due to capacity/closures/other factors, parks, rides/shows/attractions, entertainment, experience details, and/or event participation may be limited or unavailable without prior notice. Once partially/fully modified or redeemed, vouchers cannot be changed or refunded for any reason. Benefits/restrictions are subject to change without notice.

options.name: Disneyland Park California 2-Day 1-Park Ticket + Disney Lightning Lane Multi Pass
options.description: In 1955, Walt, the father of Disney, built California Disneyland in Los Angeles, which is the world's first original Disney theme park. The park is located within the California Disney Resort. There are two main parks: Disneyland Park and Disney California Adventure Park. The two parks are adjacent to each other. Visitors can visit both parks at one time and experience the joyful magic of Disney World. Come and enter the land of fairy tales and meet classic characters such as Mickey, Minnie, Disney princesses, Avengers, and Star Wars heroes.Location: Disneyland Dr, Anaheim, CA Operation Hours 08:00 - 23:00(Operating hours may change, please refer to the official website for the most updated information.)
options.termsAndConditions: Two-day ticket (reservation required for each day) Before placing your order, please check the attraction availability at disneytraveltradeinfo.com/dlrcalendar and proceed with your booking only after confirming availability. After placing your order, go to StartYourDisneylandExperience.com to register, link, and reserve your account. How to link: Select Parks & Tickets > Select Ticket and Reservation Details > Select Make Park Reservation > Select Book Theme Park Reservation > Select Link a ticket or Magic Key Pass > Enter the Ticket# or the number under the QR code. Please note that linking and booking can only be done on the website, not in the app. If your purchase includes a fast pass, it will also be linked when you link your account. Visitors who have booked the Disney Lightning Lane Multi Pass (formerly Disney Genie+) can use their ticket to access the Lightning Lane for attractions or experiences in the theme park on the day of their visit. Pass holders can select only one attraction or experience at a time and choose their fast pass options on the day of entry. Some attractions or experiences do not support the Lightning Lane Multi Pass (formerly Disney Genie+) service, and daily reservation slots are limited and subject to availability. Only one arrival window per attraction or experience can be selected each day. Pass holders must download the Disneyland Park California app (Disneyland) before entering the park to use this pass, as the user service interface is available in English only. Photos from the Disney PhotoPass One Day Pass must be downloaded before their expiration date. All photos and other digital content are subject to the expiration policy. Attraction times may change at any time, so please check the app in advance. The attraction reserves the right to modify operational requirements due to changes in operating hours, attraction closures, or park shutdowns. This pass is non-transferable and non-refundable. Visitors under 14 must be accompanied by a visitor aged 14 or above to enter the theme park. Children under 7 must be accompanied by someone aged 14 or above to board the rides. Other park rules apply. Unused admission tickets can be canceled at any time. However, if one ticket in a group booking remains unused while others have been used, the unused ticket becomes non-refundable. To avoid refund issues, consider booking tickets separately if there's a cancellation risk. Please note that any modifications made independently through the official website or at the attraction (such as upgrades) will make the ticket ineligible for refunds or changes. Opening hours may be adjusted at any time. Please check the official website before your trip to confirm the opening hours on your visit day. Due to capacity/closures/other factors, parks, rides/shows/attractions, entertainment, experience details, and/or event participation may be limited or unavailable without prior notice. Once partially/fully modified or redeemed, vouchers cannot be changed or refunded for any reason. Benefits/restrictions are subject to change without notice.

options.description: In 1955, Walt, the father of Disney, built California Disneyland in Los Angeles, which is the world's first original Disney theme park. The park is located within the California Disney Resort. There are two main parks: Disneyland Park and Disney California Adventure Park. The two parks are adjacent to each other. Visitors can visit both parks at one time and experience the joyful magic of Disney World. Come and enter the land of fairy tales and meet classic characters such as Mickey, Minnie, Disney princesses, Avengers, and Star Wars heroes. Location: Disneyland Dr, Anaheim, CA Operation Hours 08:00 - 23:00(Operating hours may change, please refer to the official website for the most updated information.)
options.termsAndConditions: Two-day ticket (reservation required for each day) Before placing your order, please check the attraction availability at disneytraveltradeinfo.com/dlrcalendar and proceed with your booking only after confirming availability. After placing your order, go to StartYourDisneylandExperience.com to register, link, and reserve your account. How to link: Select Parks & Tickets > Select Ticket and Reservation Details > Select Make Park Reservation > Select Book Theme Park Reservation > Select Link a ticket or Magic Key Pass > Enter the Ticket# or the number under the QR code. Please note that linking and booking can only be done on the website, not in the app. If your purchase includes a fast pass, it will also be linked when you link your account. Visitors who have booked the Disney Lightning Lane Multi Pass (formerly Disney Genie+) can use their ticket to access the Lightning Lane for attractions or experiences in the theme park on the day of their visit. Pass holders can select only one attraction or experience at a time and choose their fast pass options on the day of entry. Some attractions or experiences do not support the Lightning Lane Multi Pass (formerly Disney Genie+) service, and daily reservation slots are limited and subject to availability. Only one arrival window per attraction or experience can be selected each day. Pass holders must download the Disneyland Park California app (Disneyland) before entering the park to use this pass, as the user service interface is available in English only. Photos from the Disney PhotoPass One Day Pass must be downloaded before their expiration date. All photos and other digital content are subject to the expiration policy. Attraction times may change at any time, so please check the app in advance. The attraction reserves the right to modify operational requirements due to changes in operating hours, attraction closures, or park shutdowns. This pass is non-transferable and non-refundable. Visitors under 14 must be accompanied by a visitor aged 14 or above to enter the theme park. Children under 7 must be accompanied by someone aged 14 or above to board the rides. Other park rules apply. Unused admission tickets can be canceled at any time. However, if one ticket in a group booking remains unused while others have been used, the unused ticket becomes non-refundable. To avoid refund issues, consider booking tickets separately if there's a cancellation risk. Please note that any modifications made independently through the official website or at the attraction (such as upgrades) will make the ticket ineligible for refunds or changes. Opening hours may be adjusted at any time. Please check the official website before your trip to confirm the opening hours on your visit day. Due to capacity/closures/other factors, parks, rides/shows/attractions, entertainment, experience details, and/or event participation may be limited or unavailable without prior notice. Once partially/fully modified or redeemed, vouchers cannot be changed or refunded for any reason. Benefits/restrictions are subject to change without notice.

Indulge your taste buds with delectable treats inspired by your favorite Disney stories! From classic Mickey Mouse-shaped pretzels to refreshing Dole Whips
Live out your Disney dreams by meeting your favorite characters! Get a hug from Mickey Mouse, share a laugh with Goofy, or wave to your favorite princess.

options.name: Disneyland Park California 2-Day 1-Park Ticket + Disney Lightning Lane Multi Pass
options.description: In 1955, Walt, the father of Disney, built California Disneyland in Los Angeles, which is the world's first original Disney theme park. The park is located within the California Disney Resort. There are two main parks: Disneyland Park and Disney California Adventure Park. The two parks are adjacent to each other. Visitors can visit both parks at one time and experience the joyful magic of Disney World. Come and enter the land of fairy tales and meet classic characters such as Mickey, Minnie, Disney princesses, Avengers, and Star Wars heroes.Location: Disneyland Dr, Anaheim, CA Operation Hours 08:00 - 23:00(Operating hours may change, please refer to the official website for the most updated information.)
options.termsAndConditions: Two-day ticket (reservation required for each day) Before placing your order, please check the attraction availability at disneytraveltradeinfo.com/dlrcalendar and proceed with your booking only after confirming availability. After placing your order, go to StartYourDisneylandExperience.com to register, link, and reserve your account. How to link: Select Parks & Tickets > Select Ticket and Reservation Details > Select Make Park Reservation > Select Book Theme Park Reservation > Select Link a ticket or Magic Key Pass > Enter the Ticket# or the number under the QR code. Please note that linking and booking can only be done on the website, not in the app. If your purchase includes a fast pass, it will also be linked when you link your account. Visitors who have booked the Disney Lightning Lane Multi Pass (formerly Disney Genie+) can use their ticket to access the Lightning Lane for attractions or experiences in the theme park on the day of their visit. Pass holders can select only one attraction or experience at a time and choose their fast pass options on the day of entry. Some attractions or experiences do not support the Lightning Lane Multi Pass (formerly Disney Genie+) service, and daily reservation slots are limited and subject to availability. Only one arrival window per attraction or experience can be selected each day. Pass holders must download the Disneyland Park California app (Disneyland) before entering the park to use this pass, as the user service interface is available in English only. Photos from the Disney PhotoPass One Day Pass must be downloaded before their expiration date. All photos and other digital content are subject to the expiration policy. Attraction times may change at any time, so please check the app in advance. The attraction reserves the right to modify operational requirements due to changes in operating hours, attraction closures, or park shutdowns. This pass is non-transferable and non-refundable. Visitors under 14 must be accompanied by a visitor aged 14 or above to enter the theme park. Children under 7 must be accompanied by someone aged 14 or above to board the rides. Other park rules apply. Unused admission tickets can be canceled at any time. However, if one ticket in a group booking remains unused while others have been used, the unused ticket becomes non-refundable. To avoid refund issues, consider booking tickets separately if there's a cancellation risk. Please note that any modifications made independently through the official website or at the attraction (such as upgrades) will make the ticket ineligible for refunds or changes. Opening hours may be adjusted at any time. Please check the official website before your trip to confirm the opening hours on your visit day. Due to capacity/closures/other factors, parks, rides/shows/attractions, entertainment, experience details, and/or event participation may be limited or unavailable without prior notice. Once partially/fully modified or redeemed, vouchers cannot be changed or refunded for any reason. Benefits/restrictions are subject to change without notice.
howToUse: Show Mobile Ticket: Ticketing Counter

Whether you're seeking adventure, family fun, or iconic Disney moments, Disneyland Paris offers an unforgettable experience just outside Paris.

globaltix_product_data.description: Experience the magic at Disneyland Paris — Europe’s most enchanting destination where fairy tales come to life. Discover two spectacular theme parks, Disneyland Park and Walt Disney Studios Park, filled with thrilling rides, captivating shows, and unforgettable Disney characters. Step into magical lands, explore immersive attractions, and enjoy world-class entertainment suitable for all ages. Whether you're seeking adventure, family fun, or iconic Disney moments, Disneyland Paris offers an unforgettable experience just outside Paris.
highlights: Enjoy access to two Disney Parks: Disneyland Park & Walt Disney Studios Park
Visit the iconic Sleeping Beauty Castle
Experience immersive attractions at Avengers Campus
Watch spectacular parades, live shows, and nighttime fireworks
Family-friendly attractions for all ages
exclusions: All personal expenses and expenses not mentioned in the inclusions

globaltix_product_data.description: Experience the magic at Disneyland Paris — Europe’s most enchanting destination where fairy tales come to life. Discover two spectacular theme parks, Disneyland Park and Walt Disney Studios Park, filled with thrilling rides, captivating shows, and unforgettable Disney characters. Step into magical lands, explore immersive attractions, and enjoy world-class entertainment suitable for all ages. Whether you're seeking adventure, family fun, or iconic Disney moments, Disneyland Paris offers an unforgettable experience just outside Paris.
highlights: Enjoy access to two Disney Parks: Disneyland Park & Walt Disney Studios Park
Visit the iconic Sleeping Beauty Castle
Experience immersive attractions at Avengers Campus
Watch spectacular parades, live shows, and nighttime fireworks
Family-friendly attractions for all ages
exclusions: All personal expenses and expenses not mentioned in the inclusions

globaltix_product_data.description: If you only have a limited time in Venice, you have to make choices. Make those choices good ones. For example, take a tour of Venice's premiere sights with an experienced, English-speaking guide. Through captivating stories, St. Mark's Basilica, the (Doge's Palace) and the will come to life. And you'll be glad you made smart choices.The tour starts at the very center of Venice: St. Mark's Square. This used to be the political and social center of the Venetian Republic. Today it's the place where millions of tourists dock every year, but it's no less beautiful for the foot traffic. After coming to understand why Napoleon called this "the drawing room of Europe", you'll continue to St. Mark's Basilica, one of the world's most famous churches. It's survived fires, looting and storms - and not always unscathed. That's why you'll find many different architecture styles and irregularities. Giving it its unique appearance.With your guide at the front, you'll skip the long lines at the entrance to the basilica (saving you a few hours in the burning sun or pouring rain - Venice's most common weather types). Once inside you'll be struck by the opulence; 4000 m2 of mosaics glitters and shimmers in the daylight. And visit the spectacular - commissioned by the Doge in 976. This golden 'painting' is one of the richest treasures of Christianity, stuffed with 2486 gems. Much of the other treasures were 'requisitioned' by Napoleon, but your guide will fill you in on all of that! After the church you'll visit the famous , formerly the HQ and home of the Venetian Doge. The tour soaks up all the highlights of this power palace, including the gilded and marble staircases. Probably the highlight is the Great Council Hall. The entire east wall is Tintoretto's enormous painting . It's one of the world's biggest (and most beautiful) paintings. You'll also get to cross the infamous where the weary breaths of prisoners heading to the Doge's Prison would carry out into the city.All of this Venetian history and beauty will no doubt put you in the mood for a snack. So keep with the 'true blue Venetian' mood and grab some delicious (Venetian tapas) and then carry on exploring on your own.

globaltix_product_data.name: Pattaya Dolphinarium
globaltix_product_data.summary: Do you want to return to your childhood again and truly enjoy everything that is happening around you? Then the show at the dolphinarium is a great choice in order to have fun. Welcome to our unique marine mammal show! An exclusive program of performances of dolphins and seals and communication with...
globaltix_product_data.description: Do you want to return to your childhood again and truly enjoy everything that is happening around you? Then the show at the dolphinarium is a great choice in order to have fun. Welcome to our unique marine mammal show! An exclusive program of performances of dolphins and seals and communication with these amazing animals will charge you with positive emotions for many days to come. And it’s hard to describe how happy your children will be! Be sure to visit the show at the dolphinarium, and believe us – you will definitely come to us more than once!
highlights: World-Class Dolphin Show: Watch highly trained dolphins and seals perform acrobatics, jumps, and playful tricks in a lively indoor arena.
Close Animal Encounters: Upgrade your visit to swim or take photos with dolphins under the guidance of professional trainers.
Family-Friendly Attraction: Enjoy a fun and educational marine show suitable for visitors of all ages.
Modern Indoor Venue: Relax in a comfortable, climate-controlled theater with clear views of the performance pool.
Memorable Photo Moments: Capture unique moments with dolphins and seals after the show for a lasting travel memory.
inclusions: Standard Swimming : - Swim with dolphins, holding on to the dorsal and pectoral fins / dance with dolphins / get a kiss on the cheek from a dolphin.
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Admission Customers must use the service on the date specified on the ticket. If the service is used on a different date, customers will be required to purchase a new ticket onsite at the walk-in rate. Tickets are valid only for the selected date and time. The above rates are per person and inclusive of 7% VAT. Eligibility Child refers to guests whose height is between 80–120 cm, and the age must not exceed 12 years old. Children under 80 cm are considered infants and can enter free of charge under adult supervision, with no seat provided. Swimming with dolphins is permitted for adults and children aged 6 years and above. Children under 6 years old are not allowed to participate. The swimmer’s weight must not exceed 100 kilograms. For swimmers weighing 100 kilograms or more, the program may be provided with exceptions for certain parts of the activity. People with acute or chronic skin diseases, mental illnesses, cardiovascular diseases, sexually transmitted diseases, helminthiasis, other infectious diseases, those under the influence of drugs or alcohol, pregnant women, people with special needs, and those with infantile cerebral palsy are not allowed to swim with dolphins. Attraction Access Please make your booking at least 1 hour in advance before the service time. Show duration: 50 minutes per round. Swimming duration: 10 minutes per round. Additional Information The above rates are subject to availability. Customers who present a Child ticket but exceed 120 cm in height will be required to pay the price difference from Child to Adult at the Company’s selling rate before entering the show. Important Notes Free cancellation is allowed if cancelled at least 24 hours before the show time. Cancellations made less than 24 hours prior to the show time and No-Show cases will be charged 100% of the ticket price. “No-show” applies to the Agent’s customers who do not present themselves on time for the booked program and will be subject to a 100% cancellation charge to the Agent. Any cancellations or amendments must be notified to the Company in writing via email. Verbal notifications will not be accepted under any circumstances. Once tickets are issued, they are non-refundable and non-changeable. How to Get There By taxi or private car: Easily accessible by road from Pattaya city center. Public transportation options are limited; taxis are the most convenient way to reach the Dolphinarium.
globaltix_product_data.address: 555/5 Moo 1 Nong Prue Sub-disctrict, Banglamung, Chonburi Province

globaltix_product_data.description: An Enchanting Rainforest Night Walk Where legends come to life As night falls, travellers are invited to enter the Dream Forest Book Portal and into the magical realm of Sang Gedembai, the legendary keeper of stories and Guardian of the Forest. Stroll along a leisurely 1.2km trail to discover tales like the bittersweet love story of Dayang Bunting Lake, the fabled battle between mighty warrior Merong Mahawangsa and his nemesis Garuda, and… did you know Langkawi was once the home of GIANTS? Immerse yourself in their stories through mesmerising lights, music, projection mapping, art installations, interactive activities and narration. Created by Tiara Jacquelina and the award-winning team at Enfiniti - storytelling, cutting-edge technology and nature come together to create an unforgettable experience. Are you ready for a magical journey?

The 14 different zones are carefully designed around the natural environment and tell stories about Langkawi's rich history and folklore including the Legend.
This magical multi-sensory adventure is perfect for families with children of all ages.
There are discounts for Langkawi residents, MyKad holders, and senior citizens.
The park is open daily from 7pm to 12am, except for Wednesdays (unless it is a public or school holiday).

globaltix_product_data.summary: Shrek's Adventure! London is one of the British capital's most beloved and imaginatively immersive family entertainment experiences — a unique and thoroughly entertaining walkthrough attraction located on London's South Bank at County Hall, steps from the London Eye and the Thames waterfront, that i...
globaltix_product_data.description: Shrek's Adventure! London is one of the British capital's most beloved and imaginatively immersive family entertainment experiences — a unique and thoroughly entertaining walkthrough attraction located on London's South Bank at County Hall, steps from the London Eye and the Thames waterfront, that invites guests of all ages to step directly into the enchanted fairy tale world of DreamWorks Animation's most celebrated franchise. Far more than a conventional theme park or exhibition, Shrek's Adventure! is a fully immersive live-action storytelling experience in which guests become active participants in a new and original Shrek story — guided through a sequence of elaborately designed themed rooms and environments by costumed live actors, state-of-the-art 4D bus ride technology, and interactive animated story segments that blend physical theatrical performance with the most advanced digital entertainment technology available at any walkthrough attraction in London. The experience follows an original adventure narrative in which guests are magically transported to the Far Far Away kingdom and must navigate a series of fairy tale encounters — meeting familiar DreamWorks characters including Shrek, Donkey, Princess Fiona, Puss in Boots, and a colourful cast of fairy tale characters in lavishly detailed sets — before ultimately finding their way back home. The attraction's signature 4D flying theatre bus ride provides the experience's most technologically sophisticated and sensorially immersive dimension — the motion-platform vehicle combining wraparound projection, wind effects, scent, and physical movement for a genuinely exhilarating fairy tale journey. Located in one of London's most iconic and accessible riverside locations and designed for families with children of all ages, Shrek's Adventure! consistently delivers one of the most joyful, characterful, and memorably entertaining family experiences available anywhere in the United Kingdom.

globaltix_product_data.description: Why You Shouldn't Miss This The Dubai Dolphinarium is Dubai's go-to destination for a day of fun and enjoyment with your family. The adorable bottlenose dolphins, fur seals, and other wildlife will leave you amazed with their tricks and thrills. At the Dubai Dolphinarium, you also have a chance to interact with the Dolphins, catch the Dolphin & Seal show, free jump on the trampoline, and much more. Here, you will be able to enjoy a fun show of acrobatics, games, and tricks performed by dolphins and seals. Watch in wonder as they perform incredible acrobatics, dance, sing, juggle, play ball, jump through hoops and even paint! This show is an amazing 45-minute show where you can get up close and personal with these talented animals Your Experience The dolphin and seal show is a unique experience where you will see these amazing animals display their immense talents. From juggling and playing with a ball to diving on command, the dolphin and seal show is sure to win your hearts. The show takes place in the main show pool which is surrounded by an arena-style seating, with regular and VIP sections. Dubai Dolphinarium tickets are available with VIP seating and Regular seating options. VIP Seating : The VIP seats are in the center of the arena and provide the best viewing point for the show. Regular Seating: The regular seats are laid out on both sides of the VIP seats in an arc. Note: If you have purchased regular tickets, then seating is on a first-come-first-served basis. Try arriving at least 15 minutes before the show to get the best seats for the show.

Nestled in the heart of Dubai, this captivating ice rink offers a one-of-a-kind experience that will leave you breathless. As you glide across the glistening ice, you'll be mesmerized by the shimmering lights and the lively atmosphere that surrounds you. The rink is designed to transport you to a winter wonderland, regardless of the outside temperature. Whether you're a seasoned skater or a first-timer, the Dubai Ice Rink caters to all skill levels. From graceful spins to daring twirls, you can showcase your moves on the smooth, mirror-like surface. If you're a beginner, don't worry! Friendly instructors are available to guide you and help you find your balance. But the Dubai Ice Rink is more than just a skating rink; it's a hub of energy and excitement. Imagine lively music filling the air, synchronized skating performances that take your breath away, and thrilling ice hockey matches that keep you on the edge of your seat.

globaltix_product_data.description: Embark on an unforgettable journey to East Nusa Penida with Narmin Tour Bali Travel, a hidden gem nestled amidst the azure waters of the Bali Sea. Your East trip adventure begins as you step off the boat onto the sun-kissed shores of Nusa Penida. Prepare to be mesmerized by the dramatic cliffs that tower above the coastline, offering breathtaking panoramic views of the ocean below. Explore the eastern region of the island, where you’ll encounter a tapestry of natural wonders waiting to be discovered. Marvel at the iconic Kelingking Beach, often referred to as the “T-Rex” beach due to its distinctive cliff formation resembling a dinosaur. As you descend the steep cliffside staircase, you’ll be rewarded with a secluded stretch of powdery white sand and crystalline waters—a paradise for beach lovers and photographers alike. Continue your journey to Atuh Beach, a hidden oasis nestled within a secluded cove. Here, towering rock formations jut out from the turquoise sea, creating a picturesque backdrop for swimming, snorkeling, or simply soaking up the sun on the sandy shores. No trip to Nusa Penida would be complete without exploring its underwater wonders. Dive or snorkel at Crystal Bay, home to a vibrant coral reef teeming with colorful marine life, including tropical fish, sea turtles, and even manta rays if you’re lucky. After a day of exploration, immerse yourself in the island’s laid-back charm as you indulge in fresh seafood at a beachside restaurant, or simply relax and unwind as the sun sets over the horizon, painting the sky in hues of orange and pink. With its rugged beauty and untouched allure, an East trip to Nusa Penida with Narmin Tour Bali Travel promises an adventure like no other—a journey of discovery, serenity, and wonder amidst nature’s splendor.
